name: Beefbar New York
about:
Beefbar New York brings the globally acclaimed Monaco-born concept to the heart of Tribeca. Set in a stunning Art Deco space by Humbert & Poyet, the restaurant offers a luxurious yet relaxed atmosphere with high arched windows, rich marbles, and an open kitchen. The menu reimagines classic steakhouse dishes with global flair, featuring signature plates like croque sando, crispy rock corn tempura, Paradis Pepper Fillet and creamy truffle mash. Premium meat cuts from the finest producers are paired with elevated sides and sharable street-food-inspired dishes. A marble-clad bar offers refined cocktails and a curated wine list, ideal for intimate dinners or lively nights out. Beefbar New York is where timeless elegance meets modern taste, delivering a one-of-a-kind dining experience in the heart of Manhattan.

Dress code: No shorts, sweatpants, hoodies, tank top, open toe shoes for men allowed. Please consider this prior to booking your reservation.

What's the ambience/atmosphere like in this restaurant?

about: Bowery Bungalow, in the heart of SoHo, serves unconventional Mideast/Mediterrenean cuisine with cocktails, wine & beer. Full bar area and lounge, plus a dining room featuring comfortable booths and seating styles, and large group seating available. Two entrances from West Broadway and Broome St. Bowery Bungalow in California has been open 11 years and has been featured in the Michelin Bib Gourmand guide. Well known dishes include the Tahini Toast, Smokey Babaganoush, Mideast Chicken Parm, Turkish Coffee Glazed Baby Back Ribs, and Lamb Shank "Pho".

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Bowery Bungalow is a strong pick for date night. Guests praise the “cool setting, ” attentive service, and memorable flavors, making it a lively yet intimate spot in SoHo. The menu’s creative Mideast‑Mediterranean plates (think tahini toast, branzino, hummus) pair well with cocktails from the full bar for a fun, slightly adventurous evening. For a quieter experience, try an early weeknight; for a buzzy night out, weekends deliver more atmosphere.

about:
Step into the heart of authentic Mexican cuisine at Casa Carmen, a culinary sanctuary inspired by the legendary chef Carmen "Titita" Ramírez Degollado. Founded by Titita’s grandsons, the restaurant brings her celebrated recipes and rich heritage to TriBeCa.
Nestled in an earth-toned hacienda, Casa Carmen welcomes you with the aroma of traditional dishes and warm hospitality. Pair your meal with agave-based house cocktails, perfectly crafted to complement the vibrant notes of mole Xico, the complex richness of cochinita pibil, and the delicate sweetness of flan. Each dish tells a story of generations of culinary artistry.
With exposed beam ceilings and a serene atmosphere, Casa Carmen invites you to savor every moment. Whether celebrating a special occasion or indulging a craving for authentic Mexican cuisine, Casa Carmen offers a dining that lingers long after the last bite.
Please note we provide a movable ramp for the four steps at the entrance.

about: Whether you're visiting from down the block here in Tribeca or from halfway around the world, Chambers aspires to be on top of your list of favorite neighborhood restaurants. We keep it down-to-earth. We're bound to start you off with something great to drink, alcoholic or not, and maybe some snacks while you look over the menu. We went to market this morning and we're going to make some delicious home cooked food and listen to some groovy music. And we've put together an excellent collection of soulful wines, spirits, and fermented beverages that we're excited to share with you. At the end of the day, we're having a few people over for dinner. We look forward to welcoming you in.

reviews.text: One of my favorites. It's seamless, cocktails, food, service, ambiance, and the level of care and concern by owners/hosts always keep me coming back.
The best place in the whole wide world! Must get the chicken and grilled sweetbreads but I suggest going through the whole menu.
Delicious dishes, excellent service and a great ambiance. A very enjoyable experience.

This was a fantastic experience that we came all the way from Atlanta for. Sitting at the chef’s table, gives you a great visual into the kitchen.

Staff and the food and beverage team were amazing! We will be back

name: Fogo de Chão - New York - World Trade Center
address: 40 Cortlandt St tower 3 space 1340,  New York, NY 10007-3104
about: Experience continuous fire-roasted cuts including tender Picanha, juicy Fraldinha, and buttery Filet Mignon-each grilled over an open flame and carved tableside. Visit the nutrient-dense Market Table featuring seasonal salads, exotic fruits and more. Enhance your experience with fresh seafood like butter-bathed lobster tail, tender Wagyu strip and hand-crafted cocktails. Join us at The Oculus in Westfield World Trade Center, or bring the Fogo Experience home with Fogo To-Go and Catering. Founded in Southern Brazil in 1979, Fogo de Chão elevates the centuries-old Art of Churrasco into a cultural dining experience of discovery.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Fogo de Chão WTC is a popular choice for date night thanks to its warm, elegant yet casual atmosphere and tableside churrasco service. Many guests praise the beautiful dining room, lively bar area and standout steaks (Wagyu and picanha are frequently mentioned). Note that the main dining room can be lively and sometimes noisy; for a quieter, more intimate evening consider a reservation for an early seating or the bar area. Call ahead for special occasion

reviews.text: Excellent meat perfectly prepared.  Great wine list and fantastic Caipirinhas.
Our first visit to the new location  at WTC. It’s a beautiful space, the food was great, the service  was excellent as always at Fogo de Chao.  Perfect thanksgiving meal.
Excellent Thanksgiving meal. The food was delicious, so much to choose from, the service was wonderful, and the atmosphere was festive.

Was seated, waited 15 minutes for someone to greet us & offer water.  Paid for the full churasco experience- premium cuts were not served & market bar had disappointing selections.  Overall a D and that’s being gracious. The Brooklyn location was a lot better, period.

Our experience was terrible. The service was very poor. We had to ask for everything except for one server named of Marcelo, who tried to help us out even though, he said we were not setting in the area that he was serving. ??? He was very nice and was trying to help us out but overall the service was poor to nothing and the food not quite good. We have been in other Brazilian steakhouses in California where we are from And even with the Fogo de Chao over in California in San Jose. It’s much better at least it used to be in the past. We haven’t gone lately there but this one it was horrible. We’re never going back at this one and it was a very bad experience. Unfortunately. Cost very high for the poor service in bad experience. We do not recommend this place AT ALL.

name: Frenchette
about: Warmly elegant, Frenchette features a veteran kitchen serving a dining room that melds Old World glamour with New York energy. From breakfast through late-night, chefs Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr make the most of their kitchen’s rotisserie and Robata grill with daily specials crowning a menu that features Duck Frites, Turbot for Two and Spit-Roasted Lobster, all approached with a lighter, more contemporary touch. Aperitif-based cocktails are served at the striking pewter bar and an impressive selection of natural wines is on offer.

Does this restaurant have accessible or family-friendly seating?

Family-friendly, yes. Guests frequently bring families (including infants and multi‑generation groups) and report accommodating service for babies and celebrations. The space includes bar seating, banquettes and corner tables that can work well for family meals. Accessibility details (ramps, ADA seating) aren’t specified here, call ahead if you need an accessible table or specific accommodations and the team will advise.

reviews.text: Wonderful wine and Som. Food was excellent though small for the price. Charging for bread given the entrees was a bit cheeky. But everything is immaculate and one simply must have the hot chocolate at the end. GOD TIER.
Great place with amazing vibe! They keep the quality coming!

Lovely service, great cocktails, and the food is beyond amazing. Every dish is so rich and thoughtfully prepared. Don't be afraid to ask for recommendations from the staff, but regardless of what you choose you can't go wrong. The roast chicken is to die for.
Always a favorite…brought friends for their first visit and they loved it.

Food was good but certainly overpriced and over rated. This was for lunch so may be more of a tourist trap. Service was kind and efficient but impersonal. Food was well seasoned. Pancake took about 30-40 min and was drenched I syrup. Quiche the consistency of overcooked pudding. Americano was good.

about: Gigino Trattoria opened its doors in August of 1994. The owners, Bob Giraldi and Phil Suarez, along with executive chef Luigi Celentano, have kept Gigino flourishing in the ever-changing Tribeca neighborhood. Chef Celentano creates both the menu and wine list, with daily specials of seasonally fresh seafood, game and vegetables. Gigino prides itself on the fact that all their dishes are prepared to order and almost all their pastas and breads are house-made. Fresh fish specials are featured on the “specials blackboard” daily, and it’s safe to say they also have the best pizza in Tribeca! Dining at Gigino Trattoria is a pleasure every time!

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Gigino Trattoria is a lovely choice for date night. Guests frequently praise its warm, understated-elegant atmosphere, attentive service, and consistently delicious Italian dishes. Consider an early seating for a quieter, more intimate table; weekend prime time can get lively and a bit noisy. The kitchen focuses on house-made pastas, fresh daily specials and a thoughtful wine list, making it easy to plan a special evening. Reservations are recommended.

reviews.text: Overall ver enjoyable and will return. The service was somewhat chaotic, but all staff were pleasant and food was very good.

Gigino Trattoria has been a neighborhood go-to for years. The food was always reliable. However, over the past year, we have noticed a decline in the food. It's still good, but it isn't as good as it was -- the veal scallopini was tough, the ossobucco was salty and the portion was small. The risotto was just ok. The salmon was poorly cut and the portion was tiny. The house special pasta was fair and mostly left on the plate by my friend.  The pizzas are still good. While we will probably go again, or order to-go, we are disappointed and if it continues to remain an "ok" restaraunt rather than a really good one, we will stop going to Gigino Trattoria.

As requested, we were given a table on the balcony.  I was hoping for a spada as a special and was not disappointed; so tender, I cut it with my knife! The special burrata salad was great as well as the ricotta cheese cake.
Everything was superb and the service was excellent
We have been coming here for years and it is always an outstanding experience.

Who owns Gjelina - New York?

Gjelina New York is the Manhattan outpost of Gjelina, the neighborhood restaurant originally founded in Venice Beach, California. The NYC location continues the Gjelina concept; guests and reviews reference Chef Jake Epstein leading the kitchen. Specific ownership names are not listed in the provided materials, so contact the restaurant directly if you need formal ownership details.

reviews.text: Great food, service and ambiance. We sat at the bar which was very nice and had a side view into the viewable kitchen. Food was really good. Would visit again.

The food was outstanding! So many vegetarian options (although I'm not a vegetarian) and everything was so yummy. I love the ambiance and the vibe. Great downtown location. Huge duplex space. Highly recommend.

Fabulous all around! Our server Kareem knew the menu and helped us with our selections which all complimented each other. Attentive service from everyone, food was so well prepared, bursting with flavors, just fantastic!

Compared to the Santa Monica location this has far fewer vegetable dishes and flavors are also not as good as Santa Monica. 

Each dishes are also pretty pricey so not something I would frequent as my go to place. 

All things considered it was just ok.

Great food, great service. Second time we have had a reservation where we could only get in at 6 and yet we were the only table occupied in the front dining area and even when we left the first time there was no other table occupied and last night there was only one. Don't know why they make it so hard to make a reservation,

about:
Gran Morsi, named after the Italian word for “bites,” epitomizes elegant simplicity. This airy and convivial two-floor restaurant, located in the heart of Tribeca, specializes in boldly-flavored Italian fare with a strong focus on small and shared plates, many of which are cooked in the brick oven. Gran Morsi provides both downtown Manhattan residents and visitors with a dining experience fit for whatever they’re in the mood for, whether it’s a special occasion celebration, an intimate evening or a casual night out with friends. Try our Meatballs that Beat Bobby Flay!

For parties of 5 guests or more, seating will be assigned based on restaurant preference and availability. Your group may be placed in either of our dining room spaces to best accommodate your reservation and ensure optimal service! We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: Good food. Good vibes. Excellent service. Kitchen’s execution is consistent.

It was our first time there…very cool vibe and location. We ordered 3 appetizers and we each had a different entree.  The drinks were excellent, food was looked and tasted delicious and the service was on point.  I highly recommend this local find for a fun night with friends or a date night.

Cozy, inviting atmosphere, just what we were looking for!  Our waitress was delightful and knowledgeable, our only complaint was that they appeared to have her spread too thin, so we went long periods without much attention.  The food was excellent. Highly, highly recommend the Caesar salad.  So unusual!  The meatballs do seem to be award winning, and the sauce is 10/10!  Overall, it was a very good experience.  We will be back!!!

The food is good, and the ambiance is nice. They were extremely kind and accommodating about a change in scheduling. Best part of the night was the birthday candle experience. Overall, I think it is overpriced for what it is but still a nice experience.
My wife and  I brought family guests along this trip. They were just as impressed (as we always are) at the quality of the  food and the service. Both were outstanding. It was a great experience.

about: Nestled along the East River next to the historic South Street Seaport, Industry Kitchen is just steps from the water’s edge. The menu, curated by Executive Chef Jonathan Haffmans, features modern American cuisine based on seasonal market ingredients and simply prepared dishes that New Yorkers know and love, such as abundant salads and wood-oven grilled meats, seafood, and pizza. Complimenting all menu choices is a wide variety of craft beers, signature cocktails, and an extensive wine list. The stunning 5,000 square-foot venue accommodates up to 300 guests with indoor and outdoor seating, allowing for unobstructed views of the Brooklyn and Williamsburg Bridges and Brooklyn Skyline.

reviews.text: Excellent, great food, service, Christmas vibe right on the water with views

The restaurant has an impressive industrial-kitchen aesthetic that feels modern and energetic. The open layout lets you see the culinary action, which adds excitement to the dining experience. The food was well-prepared and flavorful, and the service was attentive without being intrusive. Overall, it’s a great spot for anyone who enjoys bold design paired with quality dining.

My family had a fantastic time! The entire team at Industry  Kitchen was welcoming and pleasant. Eddie took great care of us, and helped our youngest decided on a great kid friendly meal. We will definitely return.

We had a great experience at lunch yesterday. There were six of us celebrating the birthday of 10-year old twins. The staff members were all lovely and attentive. The menu was great, and the food was delicious.

I was really excited to try Industry Kitchen because it got good reviews online and on social media. I scheduled a reservation and didn’t end up needing it, as no one was dining there. The service was alright, the server acknowledged it was my birthday and asked me to pick out a dessert from the menu. When we got the bill I was charged for the dessert - which granted I didn’t clarify, but don’t offer a sundae for a special occasion and then charge me $17 for it. The food was overpriced for the quality. The flatbread and pizza arrived at just over room temperature despite there being no one dining in the restaurant besides a few tables outside. The fries were undercooked. We spent a total of 2.5 hours dining which I felt was way too long again for nobody being there. The total bill was $140 AFTER a $50 off $100+ order for 3 drinks, a flatbread, a pizza, fries, and the “birthday” sundae. I wouldn’t come back nor recommend this restaurant.

about: In its bright and airy modern bistro, Joseph Leonard serves modern American fare with a rustic twist. Appetizers include a charcuterie board with meats and cheeses, caramelized cauliflower with mustard vinaigrette and grilled asparagus with shrimp. Popular entrée items, such as the roasted chicken with English peas, steamed mussels topped with bacon in a white wine sauce and hen of the woods mushrooms with potato gnocchi, speak to the variety and high-quality ingredients utilized at Joseph Leonard. In addition to typical items like strawberry shortcake and chocolate mousse cake, a gourmet selection of cheeses are on the dessert menu. Craft beer and specialty cocktails add to the contemporary feel of Joseph Leonard. Try the gentleman caller, with bourbon, peach tea, lemon and honey for a cool and refreshing addition to your meal.

name: Lafayette
about: Lafayette is an everyday French restaurant conducting the spirit of French dining anew in downtown Manhattan’s NoHo neighborhood. Open morning, noon and night, this grand café and bakery is dedicated to Chef Andrew Carmellini's market-driven bistro cooking in a timeless hallmark setting. Our light-flushed dining room features soaring arched windows overlooking the NoHo streetscapes and a lively rotisserie bar. Our corner boulangerie-patisserie is open all hours offering artisanal breads, croissants, Stumptown coffee drinks, a light breakfast or lunch and a host of confections. In warm weather months, our sidewalk cafe opens daily for open air breakfast, lunch, brunch and dinner service.

about: Celebrity Chef/Owner Joey Campanaro introduces Little Owl’s twin: The Chef’s Room—an intimate dining room inside the iconic Friends Building, The One Where They Go to a Party. We welcome reservations for Lunch, Brunch, Dinner, and Private Dining in Manhattan’s West Village, at one of the most beloved NYC restaurants. With Wine Director Lisa Komara’s curated list & our private collection, we serve seasonal Mediterranean-American cuisine with fresh, local ingredients. Signature dishes like our famous Little Owl Gravy Meatball Sliders, the iconic West Village Pork Chop, and Joey’s seasonal touch made us a cornerstone New York restaurant known for killer playlists, genuine hospitality, and local charm. faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Little Owl is a classic West Village choice for date night. Guests frequently praise its cozy, intimate rooms, attentive service, and creative, well-executed dishes (think halibut, risotto, and the famous meatball sliders). The mood is warm and lively, with a smart wine list and cocktails that round out a romantic evening. If you prefer a quieter experience, request the Chef’s Room or an early seating.

reviews.text: Super cute place. The food was exceptional. The service was amazing. Love the staff. They are so sweet and friendly. Didn’t realize this restaurant was above the iconic building for friends.
Adriane greeted us with care. So sweet! We felt like we were welcomed into their home. Food was amazing - I had scallops that melted in your mouth. Go!!

Little Owl was perfect in what we needed on Saturday evening...a cozy, intimate dinner with a delicious meal and fabulous wine, yum!  Jordan was the most hospitable host and we appreciate the service putting guests first and foremost with class and accommodation.  Needless to say, one of our favorites in the West Village 💜  Thank you.

I had a wonderful experience at Little Owl. All the staff were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. The food was absolutely delicious. We ate in the chef's room, a second dining room near the main location, and the ambiance was warm, cozy, and inviting. I would happily dine at Little Owl again.

A superb Thanksgiving dinner at Little Owl.  The Chef's Room was warm and cozy and redolent of the season; the service as always was perfection: friendly and highly knowledgeable.  Three courses for $95, which strikes me as a Thanksgiving bargain.  We both began with the tortelli--Emilia-Romagna's beautiful take on ravioli--filled with potato and tangy cheese and surrounded by a beautiful brown butter sauce that was a nutty and sweet complement to the pasta.  My husband went traditional--a beautiful turkey, white and dark meat, cooked with Riesling and served with giblet gravy, stuffing, and cranberry.  Since he had licked the pasta plate clean we had some turkey leftovers to bring home!  I had the halibut on a bed of chive mashed potatoes, surrounded by a scrumptious lobster and butter sauce, and I left not a crumb.  Enormous, family-sized portions of sides were offered at $15.  We ordered--unnecessarily, but deliciously--sweet potatoes with brown sugar and ginger.  Dismiss all nightmare memories of a gooey mash covered with marshmallows; these sweet potatoes were served in slabs like fat steak fries, the not-too-sweet sauce made syrupy by the brown sugar.  Lovely.  With this wonderful food we had a divine fruity but dry Riesling, which our helpful server had perfectly described to us.  Then we both had a flaky, hot apple streudel accompanied by a cold, creamy vanilla gelato for dessert.  It was festive, it was delicious, it was convivial, and he went home to an immaculate kitchen.  The perfect Thanksgiving.

name: Little Ruby's - West Village
about:
Since 2003, Little Ruby’s Cafe has brought Australian cafe culture to New York City, offering approachable all-day fare, specialty drinks, and a full coffee program. Open for brekkie, lunch and dinner 7 days a week, Little Ruby’s Cafe’s beloved menu features the signature burgers, pastas, salads and brunch classics, all served in thoughtfully designed spaces.

Located on the landmark corner of West 4th St & 7th Avenue, our newest Little Ruby’s Cafe features an airy, multi-level space. A first for Little Ruby’s, West Village offers a full bar with an exclusive cocktail program alongside our classic menu with new dishes unique to the location. With an expansive terrace and sweeping windows, the West Village restaurant invites guests to absorb the energy of the neighborhood as they enjoy their morning brekkie or grab cocktails and dinner with friends.

Little Ruby’s West Village is be open 7 days a week for brekkie, lunch and dinner.

name: Meximodo - Jersey City
address: 25 Christopher Columbus Dr,  Jersey City, NJ 07302
about:
Bar seating is Walk In Only, no Reservations Required!
Meximodo is a modern casa for bold Mexican cooking, legendary margaritas, and a world-record-breaking tequila bar. Our chefs fire-kiss al pastor on the trompo, slow-braise birria until it melts, and hand-press warm tortillas for tacos piled high with market-fresh salsas and crisp-bright ceviches. The bar is pure theater: lime squeezed to order, salt-rim rituals, frozen swirls and top-shelf, shaken-hard margaritas, plus agave flights that journey from tequila blancos to single-village mezcals. With a record-setting wall of rare bottles and private tequila lockers waiting for your name, Meximodo turns every night into a celebration. High-energy vibes, generous hospitality, and flavors that hit like a drum. Come for the tacos and margs, stay to explore the collection. Welcome to Meximodo: where Mexico’s soul meets modern style, and every sip and bite brings you back for more.

name: Pranakhon
about: Pranakhon brings the vibrant flavors of Bangkok to New York City’s Greenwich Village. This trendy Thai restaurant captures the essence of Thailand's bustling street food scene with a menu inspired by the diverse offerings found in Bangkok's alleyways. Enjoy classic and innovative dishes like the spicy Krapow Moo Krob and comforting Khao Tom Seafood, all made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and traditional techniques. Step into a stylish space filled with vibrant colors and intricate Thai artwork, where our friendly staff will guide you through the menu to ensure a memorable experience. Whether you're a Thai food lover or trying it for the first time, Pranakhon has something for everyone. Start with the crispy Gai Manow, battered chicken served with tangy lime mayonnaise, and savor the rich Pad Ped Nuer, a homemade curry stir-fried with tender beef shank. Join us for a culinary journey that transports you straight to Thailand.

reviews.text: I absolutely love RH Rooftop - one of my fave top restaurants in NYC - and chose is to have my birthday dinner with friends. The restaurant manager Ryan and the entire team went out of their way to ensure we had the most lovely experience!! From the moment I walked in, I didn’t have to worry about anything and could just relax and enjoy an amazing dinner with friends. I love the atmosphere because it’s truly one of the most gorgeous dining spaces in the city - with the chandeliers, greenery, and beautiful furniture. And the tables are spaced out well so you don’t feel cramped like at so many other restaurants. It feels like a private dining experience in a beautifully designer decorated home! And the food - wow the food! The best burger in NYC!!! I had told all my friends about the burger so everyone decided to get it - and they too were blown away! I always get mine with the added avocado. And I also always get the gem lettuce salad on the side. We got 2 salads to share as a table and everyone agreed the salad was so good! We started with mini lobster rolls with caviar - the most perfect amuse bouche! Everyone love them. We then split a plate of the crispy artichoke. And then had our burgers and gem lettuce salad. For drinks - we of course had the Bellinis!!! The best Bellini in North America! It’s just like the Bellinis at the famous Harry’s bar in Venice! I rarely ever drink alcohol but always get a Bellini at RH Rooftop cause it’s that good! For dessert, I had arranged to bring my own special birthday cake and the staff took care of ensuring it was plated and presented beautifully with candles. name: San Sabino
about:
San Sabino is a seafood focused restaurant from wife and husband team, chefs Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli, in partnership with Quality Branded.

After working in some of NYC’s top Italian restaurants and dreaming of opening their own special neighborhood spot, Angie and Scott opened Don Angie in 2018 to tremendous critical acclaim. They quickly became known for boldly unexpected dishes that challenge your perception of traditional Italian-American cooking.

Six years later and just a few doors down from Don Angie, they've now opened their second restaurant, San Sabino.

Named after Scott’s grandfather (from Sanza, Italy, where most people are named after the patron saint Sabino), San Sabino offers a playful spin on Italian dishes from Shrimp Parm to Pasta Alle Vongole, with bold twists influenced by coastal American cities where many Italians settled, from New Orleans to the Jersey Shore.

name: SAPPE
about:
SAPPE is a trip to explore something unique, authentic and ethereal. Our guest will be indulged and pampered through all their five perceptions; visual, auditory, olfactory, haptic and gustatory. SAPPE is the extraordinary place where people come to rejoice and revel.

The train market and street food style are what SAPPE aim to offer. The vibe of bustling ambience of train station, the food stalls that offer street bites ‘ปิ้งย่าง (Ping-Yang)’ which is variety of grilled goodies on bamboo skewers and BBQ, as well as the bold flavor of E-San style cuisine are what SAPPE is looking to introduce.

Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Serafina Tribeca is a popular choice for date night. Guests praise its warm, casual Italian atmosphere, lively bar area and rooftop seating, which make for a romantic, people‑watching experience. name: Soothr
about: Soothr, properly pronounced “Sood” is the Thai word meaning “Recipe”. This East Village establishment is the vision of close friends who grew up in different regions of Thailand, hoping to share their experiences and recipes with the rest of the world. Raised in distinctive regional cities, each individual brings their own unique relationship with Thai cuisine, with a specific focus on the generational family recipes that have shaped their childhood and time growing up in Thailand. With a specialty in family noodle recipes from throughout Thailand, Soothr offers a culinary experience that is geared towards the comfort and warmth of dining at home. These traditional recipes have brought great comfort and a sense of home for generations, and Soothr at its core is an invitation to sit at the table and enjoy a classic, Thai family meal.

Note it’s often loud, the dining room is tight, and service can feel fast-paced with a typical 90‑minute table rhythm, so it’s better for an energetic evening than a slow, romantic conversation. Consider an earlier seating or the bar for a

reviews.text: Lovely family dinner.  The service was good and the food came out fast.  Maybe too fast??? I wouldn’t reorder the ribs nor the pad see ew.  Everything else was fantastic.

Soothr is one of the better Thai restaurants in New York and has a Michelin rating. Staff are warm, friendly and responsive. The ambience is cozy and it felt like we were back in Thailand. A cocktail was superb in both taste and presentation. A vegetarian noodle bowl was delicious, somewhat unusual from other Thai restaurants in NY and enough for two people. We also ordered the branzino (the most expensive entree), but found this to be bland. Unusually presented with its large open cavity in the center of the dish, the cavity was mostly empty with an occasional bland cashew and a few julienned vegetables. The two desserts were very good including a refreshing rose sorbet with an Aiyu jelly and a mango sundae.

Every dish has so much flavor. Will definitely go back. We shared the eggplant salad, the duck rolls, the chicken pad ki-mao, a beef dish and the pea shoots. All were amazing. The only hard part is reading the menu and choosing.

Did lunch here and the value was unbeatable! One of the best meals I had in NY. Highly recommend the duck spring rolls and the dry crab noodles. Food was only outdone by friendly and attentive service.
Never had a bad experience eating at Soothr. If you’re lucky enough to get a seat in the back of the restaurant, you’ll be able to really enjoy the music selection too

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
When is the best time to go to Temple Court?

Best time depends on your vibe: for a quieter, polished meal try weekday lunch or early dinner, guests described lunch as “sophisticated and quiet.” For a lively, celebratory evening atmosphere, reserve a dinner slot on a weekend. Restaurant Week and holiday meals (e.g., Christmas lunch) are popular for value but busier; if you want a calmer experience, pick midweek or an earlier seating and mention any celebration when booking.

reviews.text: All of the food was world class, with an extra touch of comfort.  The wait staff were knowledgeable and very attentive, without feeling too formal. I'd definitely eat there again.  Tom Colicchio is 3 for 3 at his restaurants I've had the pleasure to eat at.

I had a wonderful dining experience at Temple Court! From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the perfect location of our table.The ambiance was inviting and made for a delightful evening.

The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring that we had everything we needed. Their warm hospitality added to the overall positive experience.

As for the food, it was simply delicious! Each dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor. I especially loved their Foie Gras, which were outstanding.

Overall, I highly recommend Temple Court to anyone looking for a fantastic meal in a great setting. I can't wait to return!

about:
Discover Tiny's & the Bar Upstairs, a charming family-run restaurant in a historic pink townhouse in Tribeca. Enjoy a warm atmosphere ideal for intimate dinners, lively gatherings, or casual drinks. Our menu features modern American cuisine with Italian and French influences, highlighting the freshest seasonal ingredients. Start with our curried spinach dip or try the melt-in-your-mouth dry-aged burger. For something lighter, the beet salad with goat cheese is a must-try.

Head upstairs to the Bar, where a sophisticated ambiance awaits. Enjoy expertly crafted cocktails like the Peach Fizz or choose from our extensive wine selection. Our small plates are perfect for sharing with friends.

Whether you're looking for a romantic dinner, a fun night out, or a cozy place to relax, Tiny's & the Bar Upstairs promises an unforgettable experience with warm hospitality and delicious cuisine. Visit us and see why we’re a Tribeca favorite.

Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Tiny’s is a popular choice for date night. Guests praise its cozy, intimate setting in a historic pink Tribeca townhouse and the upstairs bar adds a slightly more sophisticated spot for pre- or post-dinner drinks. The menu leans modern American with sharable small plates (burrata, hamachi carpaccio) and standout mains (steak, branzino, paella), so it’s easy to create a romantic, multi-course evening. Consider an early reservation to avoid peak wait times

name: Tucci
about: Tucci is a labor of love that honors the Tucci family's legacy, serving refined modern Italian cuisine and family recipes in a warm and inviting atmosphere. The restaurant features the distinctive Tucci touch across two levels of dining. The main floor boasts intimate handcrafted banquets, velvet drapes and floor-to-ceiling windows, making the perfect atmosphere for a sublime evening. The lower level dining and cocktail lounge has brick and stone arches dating back to the 1800s, as well as a massive, exquisite handmade bar to complement specially curated cocktails and private dining areas that resemble Tuscan wine cellars. The restaurant is ideal for special occasions and events of all sizes.

faqs.answer:
What is this restaurant's stand-out or favorite dish?

There isn’t a single unanimous dish, but several items are frequently praised: the Baked Clams Oreganata, seasonal ravioli (guests loved a sweet corn ravioli), and the lasagna and chicken parm earn repeat mentions. The menu also features showstoppers like Delmonico ribeye and Branzino, many guests recommend trying the bread and shareable antipasti to start.

reviews.text: I feel like 11 Tigers is a best kept secret I want to tell everyone. Can’t wait to come back in a couple weeks.
This place used to be great! Not so much anymore…too noisy, food not as good.

Go here, they do have great food-

However, I was so excited to go here since I had heard such good things from a friend who went just last weekend- and when my girls and I went- it was just confusing once we walked in the door, there was no hostess to sit us, there was a weird direction in the restaurant & once we sat we asked for menus.. but there are no paper menus, it’s only a barcode to scan on your phone- and I know this is of the times, but then the owner of this place needs to provide the servers the wifi and password for the customers dining inside the restaurant. I hate to be a Karen, but this place is good, but it could be SO much better if it just worked on a few small details.  WiFi & password, a cleaner bathroom, paper menus for your more traditional clientele & also more vegetables throughout the traditional entrees. I’ll be coming back here, but when I do I hope some changes have been made so it’s a more enjoyable experience. Many thanks to this place either way, the chefs saved the day for sure.
Loved the food. The flaming drinks were a wondering surprise.

ehhhhh. Honestly expected more. Seeing the menu online made me very excited but when we got there we were greeted with teeny tiny QR codes on tables. When we asked for physical menus we were given a pretty condescending “no”. Service was slow, we ordered the crispy rice tuna and got tuna on a rice cake, crispy chicken was pretty good, small portions for the wagyu (which definitely wasn’t wagyu). Just lower your expectations. Another overpriced and underwhelming meal. For better Thai go to Soothr.

name: 19 Cleveland
about:
Rooted in flavor and full of life, 19 Cleveland brings the vibrant spirit of the modern Mediterranean to SoHo NYC. Whether you're looking for a night out with friends or escaping for a quick weekday lunch, every meal here feels like a mini vacation — no passport required.

Our menu is a bold blend of Mediterranean traditions and global inspirations, from spicy Thai fish to silky Italian pastas to soulful shakshuka. It’s casual dining redefined — fresh, eclectic, and designed to be shared. Inspired by the cultural melting pot of the middle-east we celebrate the flavors brought together by generations of immigrants who cook with creativity, curiosity, and joy.

The atmosphere is lively, the crowd effortlessly cool, and the setting perfect for anything from a laid-back lunch to a vibrant evening out.

A neighborhood favorite with a cult following from locals and visitors around the globe. Join us and see what the buzz is about, book now!

about:
Welcome to 3 Giovani!

We are a cozy, contemporary Italian restaurant serving pizza, wine, pasta dishes & regional Tuscan cuisine.

*Due to the of limited capacity of our restaurant and out of respect for our staff and other patrons, please note that cancellations within one hour of the reservation / no shows will incur a fee of $15 per guest*

Dress Code: Guest attire can elevate or diminish the experience of others. We consider hats, tank tops, flip flops, and team athletic attire too casual for our restaurant. Our staff takes pride in their appearance and we ask our guests to respect our attire guidelines.

Requests for outdoor seating are taken into consideration but we cannot guarantee outdoor seating.

Out of consideration for other guests who are waiting, we may ask for your table if a significant amount of time has passed. We typically never make this request short of 90 minutes after you are seated.

name: ABC Cocina
about: The second to open of the abc restaurant trio was abc cocina, a stark contrast of menu and interior design to abc kitchen. Moody lighting and shareable small Latin-inspired plates encourage large groups to enjoy a family style feast or date night by candlelight. The menu celebrates local produce and international flavors, featuring a variety of dishes and house-made cocktails such as Margaritas and Sangria, available à la carte or in large format pitchers. As a Jean-Georges restaurant, abc cocina offers a vibrant dining experience with a lively bar scene, communal tables and cozy nooks, inviting parties of all sizes. The restaurant is open for lunch, brunch, happy hour, and dinner, inviting guests to savor its diverse culinary offerings throughout the day.

name: ABC Kitchen
about:
Since opening in 2010, situated steps away from the Union Square Greenmarket, abc kitchen has celebrated community and local producers. Specializing in seasonal American cuisine with Jean-Georges’ signature touch (spice, acidity and Asian flares sprinkled throughout), abc kitchen is a Jean-Georges restaurant that partners with a diverse network of farmers and purveyors including Norwich Meadows Farm, Eckerton Hill Farm, Bodhi Tree Farm, Lani’s, and many more.

The restaurant’s regularly rotating food and beverage menus showcase organic ingredients, ranging from fresh greens to meats and fruits. Set amidst rich natural woods, abc kitchen offers a cozy ambiance that invites guests to savor celebrated seasonal dishes and local harvests in a warm and inviting setting.

name: abcV
about:
abcV sprouted from abc kitchen and is inspired by Jean-Georges’ personal journey as well as the cultural shift towards a plant-based future. The 75-seat restaurant specializes in plant-forward, sustainable, and organic dishes, alongside tonics, elixirs, and more that promote wellness for both the body and the planet. Recognized in the New York Times Top 100, abcV stands out for its innovative approach to plant-based dining.

Designed with a luminous aesthetic inspired by the energy of the sun and moon, abcV’s interiors complement the high vibration foods served, offering a balanced experience of beauty, wellness, wisdom, and love. abcV welcomes all diners, including non plant-based eaters, to enjoy its innovative and delicious offerings. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, abcV invites guests to embrace a plant-based dining experience throughout the day.

reviews.text: Food was amazing.  Loved the broiled tofu with matsutake mushrooms!
Lovely experience. Food was flavorful and unique. Loved it for a group birthday celebration. Drinks were wonderful too!

We had 4 in our party. EVERYTHING we ordered was beautiful and absolutely delicious!  I wish we lived in NYC - this would be one of our favorites for ourselves and to take friends to. The roasted cauliflower was probably the favorite as well as the cornmeal-crusted oyster mushrooms, but we all tried each others and there just wasn’t a bad dish among them. Both drinks we tried (one alcoholic, one not) were well-balanced and delicious. The presentation of everything was fabulous. And for dessert - the fig tart!

We visited abcV for my birthday brunch. The design of the interior, along with the glassware and cutlery, was amazing. 
However, we found that the food was not very authentic; it was simply spicy (we ordered a crispy cornmeal-crusted shiitake sandwich and a sunshine kabocha), which made it difficult to recognize any other flavors. The dates for starters were good, and the dessert was okay. We ordered non-alcoholic cocktails, but it was unclear from the menu that they were not homemade and instead came from a bottle. 
The service was fair, but our waiter couldn't explain what kabocha was. Later, as the place got busier, it became extremely noisy, and we had to shout to hear each other. I suppose this is normal in New York.
Maybe we need to explore other options from the menu.
Beautiful place to celebrate a special occasion. Unique flavors and presentations.

name: Ainslie Bowery
about:
Some things to know when booking with us!

Due to high volume,
No outside decorations or balloons are allowed for non private reservations.
Outside desserts are welcome for a non-waivable fee of $50 per outside dessert.
A specific dining room cannot be guaranteed.
For any special requests, please leave a note in your reservation.
We do not seat incomplete parties.
An increase in headcount may not be accommodable, please contact us to confirm your request.

** Brunch Reservations **
All parties of 9 and under are subject to a 90 minute table limit.
All Parties of 10 or more are subject to a 120 minute table limit.


** Large Party Reservations (10+) **
For parties of 10 or more, we require a different type of dining experience, called Family Style.
Guest are required to order from our "Family Style Menu" up to 72-hours prior to their reservation.
Any reservations without a "Family Style Menu" submitted 24-hours in advance, will be subject to cancellation.

Hope to see you soon!

reviews.text:
Despite being able to book a reserved table (which was recommended by the venue after securing event tickets for midnight hour), all the staff acted like they had no idea about reservations/wouldn't honor it, even after showing them our open table confirmation. One staff member allowed us to sit an an available table and another staff approached asking us why we were sitting there and who allowed it. The staff that allowed us to sit also allowed us to order (very overpriced drinks) to the table via a QR code and after the server brought the first round we were told we were not allowed to do that anymore, they removed the QR code from our table and said we needed to come to the bar for more drinks. Additionally, the DJ for the midnight hour was terrible - he didn't stick with the theme, he was rude when we made one request, and tried to state that he didn't have the song (which is a very common/popular song that was on track with the theme night). He then said he had it and would play it but never did. After giving another 45 minutes to an hour to improve, we gave up and went somewhere else with better service that delivers on expectations. We were really unimpressed all around. 

I will say, there was one bar tender who was fantastic and very nice - he was working the right side of the bar and was prompt, helpful, and great customer service. Even though we had to go to the bar when we reserved table service, he was by far the highlight of our experience that night. Unfortunately, due to everything else, we won't be back!

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Amici Ristorante is a popular choice for date nights. Guests frequently praise the cozy Little Italy setting, attentive service, and standout dishes like carbonara, tiramisu and fresh pasta that make evenings feel special. Expect a casual‑elegant vibe with table-side service and intimate seating; it’s a great spot for a relaxed romantic dinner. For a quieter table, consider an early reservation or weekday visit.

reviews.text: This was, honestly, the best Italian food I've had in my life. The staff was amazing and the atmosphere was authentic feeling, with candles and low lighting. I don't normally write reviews, so that tells you how much I loved it. Highly recommended.

Our server was very helpful but the food here just wasn’t good. Maybe it was an off night but the sauce tasted burnt. Our eggplant appetizer was mushy and lacked flavor. It just wasn’t the tasty Italian meal we were hoping for on our anniversary.
Excellent service in a very nice ambience.   One of the few legitimate Italian food restaurants left in Little Italy.
The food and drinks were really good. Definitely made fresh.
The gnocchi with Pesto sauce was incredible and my wife's veal was awesome. We had a beautiful table to sit at right along side the road and the service was outstanding.

name: Andrew Steak
about:
Coming SoonLocated in the heart of East Village, our steakhouse brings a modern New York energy to the timeless art of fire-driven cooking. Guests will find expertly sourced cuts, dry-aged in-house and grilled to bold, aromatic perfection. The menu balances signature steaks with elevated sides, seasonal small plates, and a curated wine list built around old-world reds and boutique American producers.
Inside, the space blends East Village character with refined comfort: warm lighting, textured wood, and a lively bar where craft cocktails meet honest hospitality. Whether you’re celebrating, having a business dinner, or simply craving a perfectly cooked ribeye, we create an experience that feels both familiar and unforgettable.
From first sip to final bite, our focus is simple: great ingredients, genuine service, and the kind of meal that stays with you long after the night ends.”

details.hours_of_operation: Tue–Sun 4:00 pm–12:00 am

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
How is Andrew Steak restaurant rated?

Andrew Steak is rated 4.9 stars by 71 OpenTable diners.

reviews.text: came here on a friday night and the place was buzzing the music was chill the bartenders were joking with everyone and the food was incredible i ordered the grilled salmon and it was honestly one of the best i’ve had tender flavorful and cooked perfectly.

I’ve tried so many steakhouses in Manhattan and Andrew’s definitely ranks high on the list. The seasoning the crust the temperature everything was perfect. The staff really knows their menu and the energy inside just feels elevated. It’s one of those restaurants that makes you want to come back the next day.

We had a long day and wanted a quiet dinner and this place was the best idea. The moment we sat down everything felt calm and comforting. The steak was rich and flavorful and the cornbread muffin with honey butter was unreal. The service made us feel so appreciated.

I wasn’t expecting the vibe here to be this good. The ambiance feels classy but still has the cozy neighborhood feel. The filet was buttery and tender and the brussels sprouts were crispy perfection. Our drinks were strong and balanced. Everything about this place made the night smooth and memorable.

I brought my parents here while they were visiting the city and they loved every part of the night. The staff made them feel right at home and the steaks came out exactly the way we ordered. My mom kept talking about the cornbread and the garlic butter. Such a great family dinner spot.

A rustic new tequileria y restaurante in Tribeca that owes its soul to Mexico. Here you'll find what is quite possibly the most eclectic selections of tequilas, mezcals, and Mexican distillations this side of the Hudson. An assortment that perfectly complements each and every dish on the inspired menu created by chef Ricardo Camacho. All served in a warm, inviting, authentically artistic environment. Original takes on traditional tastes.

Please note that a reservation guarantees a table but not a location. Please call ahead for preferred seating & we will do our best to accommodate.

about:
Antique Garage SoHo is converted from an old mechanic shop to a Mediterranean restaurant surrounded by antiques offers an eclectic, unique and romantic ambiance, charming and elegant in the tradition of old New York. We have a sister location in Tribeca.

We serve lunch and dinner daily as well as brunch on weekends, accompanied by live jazz music.
For parties of 12-20 more, Antique Garage offers a prix fixe menu.
Antique Garage is delighted to welcome larger parties and private events. For more information, please visit our website. If you'd like to reach out to our team directly, you can email us at events@antiquegarage.com.

reviews.text: Love this place!  Spicey Margs are my favorite drink and all the food is fresh and delicious!!!
Fantastic decor, great service and food to match. A lovely restaurant overall. Able to cater for Gluten Free so added bonus.
My friends and I had an amazing time! Our server was fabulous, she made my birthday dinner special. Thank you so much! We will be back❤️
Delicious food and ambience! From appetizers, entrees, to dessert, we loved all of it

We had such a nice meal. Four of us, were able to get a same day reservation at 7:30 so I was actually a little worried! Nothing to worry about though, service and food was top notch and all at a decent value for NYC. Drinks were good, nice wine choices too. Not too loud but definitely lively. My ONLY complaint is that there is only ONE toilet for the whole restaurant. There was always a line. At one point a staff member was in there for what seemed an eternity, but apparently was on his break and needed some privacy so unfortunately he chose the bathroom.

name: Aqua Kyoto
about: With the city’s longest sushi bar at its core, Aqua Kyoto explores contemporary Japanese cuisine through inventive plates like crystal sushi and robata-grilled pork belly—alongside Japan’s most loved classics.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
What seating arrangements/rooms does this restaurant have?

Aqua Kyoto features a prominent, long sushi bar as the focal point of the room and standard dining seating throughout. The restaurant accepts large parties but does not offer private-party/private dining rooms, so larger groups can be accommodated in the main dining area. For big celebrations it’s best to call ahead so the team can prepare seating arrangements.

reviews.text: They “couldn’t find my reservation” even though it was clearly in their system. They took 25 minutes to seat me. The food was fine but we were seated in an area all alone so there was no vibe.
Check in was very welcoming. Our servers Januel and Maria were excellent. We had an amazing dinner. Food was well made. Very flavorful. Overall it was a very good experience.

name: Aqua Roma
about: Aqua Roma celebrates the art of Italian dining with handmade pastas, bold flavors, and a cosmopolitan flair. Set in dramatic, design-forward interiors, it offers a vibrant backdrop for both intimate dinners and lively gatherings. Guests dining in Aqua Roma also enjoy the unique opportunity to order from the menu of its sister restaurant, Aqua Kyoto, creating a seamless dual culinary experience under one roof. After the meal, the evening can flow naturally into Aqua Spirit, the adjoining bar and lounge, where cocktails and conversation carry on late into the night.

name: Aquarelle
about:
Tucked into one of Manhattan most vibrant and beloved neighborhoods, Aquarelle brings the coastal soul of the Mediterranean to the East Village — one plate at a time.

From the sun-kissed shores of Southern Italy and the Greek Islands to the spice-laced coasts of North Africa and the Levant. Our menu offers a curated journey across the Mediterranean, highlighting the freshest seafood prepared with authenticity, care, and creativity.

What makes us special?

A rotating selection of crudo — raw, pristine seafood dressed simply to let the ingredients shine.

Signature dishes inspired by regions spanning from Sicily to Santorini, Antalya to Alexandria

A vibrant, coastal-inspired atmosphere that blends Old World charm with East Village edge

Locally sourced ingredients, global techniques, and bold, clean flavors

Whether you're savoring delicate scallop crudo, charcoal-grilled octopus, or whole branzino kissed with lemon and herbs — every bite is a passport to the Mediterranean.

details.private_party_facilities: Aquarelle offers stunning private dining in NYC's East Village. Our Mediterranean seafood restaurant features intimate spaces from our elegant VIP Room to atmospheric Below The Deck area. With underwater-themed décor and sustainable seafood, we create unforgettable events for 12-300 guests.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Does this restaurant have accessible or family-friendly seating?

Partly, guests frequently bring families and celebrate birthdays here, and staff have accommodated parties with children (extra forks, small touches). Aquarelle also offers private-party options for family gatherings. If you need wheelchair access or specific accessible seating, call ahead to confirm exact arrangements, since official accessibility details aren’t listed.

reviews.text: This place is perfect for special occasions. The lighting is gorgeous the staff so kind and the seafood is incredibly high quality. One of my favorite NYC restaurant experiences.
The seafood risotto here is unbelievable. Creamy but still light and full of flavor. Aquarelle NYC knows how to prepare seafood the right way.
We had the best girls night at Aquarelle. The cocktails were strong but smooth and the seafood pasta was perfect. Amazing service the whole night. Definitely top tier.
had the grilled octopus and wow it was perfect. soft texture good seasoning and a nice char. aquarelle is easily one of the best seafood restaurants in lower manhattan.
Excellent food and beautiful atmosphere.  Waiter was kind and helped make it a perfect experience.

about:
In the fast-paced rhythm of New York City, At Cave invites you to slow down and savor the moment. Here, Asian fusion cuisine meets contemporary creativity — where Eastern elements are reimagined through modern techniques. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted to balance familiar comfort with small, unexpected surprises, reflecting our passion for harmony and innovation.

This is just the beginning, as more inspired creations will soon join our menu to delight your palate. Whether you’re here for an intimate dinner, a casual gathering, or a private event, we welcome you to experience the unique journey of taste and discovery at At Cave. We also offer catering and event services upon request.

What are the portion sizes like at this restaurant?

Portions vary, the menu emphasizes tapas and shareable plates ideal for sampling and passing around, while entrées (like Steak and Fries or Atlantic Salmon) are full-sized mains. If you prefer a larger meal, combine a couple of tapas with an entrée or choose one of the sharing boards for groups.

about:
Welcome to BALVANERA! The first restaurant of Argentine Chef Fernando Navas (elBulli, Nobu, SUSHISAMBA), BALVANERA represents the food, drink & spirit of Buenos Aires - porteña cuisine with influences from the dynamic regions of Argentina. The menu, from inspired and traditional small plates and composed vegetable dishes to signature, pasture-raised meats and friends & family-style platos is a journey from Fernando's culture through his time working in great kitchens in Barcelona, Miami and New York City.

The wine list has been developed in collaboration with Argentine Sommelier Nicolas Martianhes. The program showcases a noteworthy selection of new world wines (primarily Argentine/South American), some old world gems and a curated selection of beer.

Guests can enjoy a vibrant Monday night BYOB scene, partake in an Argentine Feast Sunday-Thursday nights, raise a glass during bottomless brunch or gather friends for an evening of great food, wine and company!

faqs.answer:
What are the portion sizes like at this restaurant?

Portions vary by dish: expect shareable small plates/tapas and composed vegetable dishes alongside hearty, restaurant-quality steaks. Guests frequently order a mix of platitos (small plates), empanadas and then a steak or “tabla” for two, so it’s easy to share and build a full meal. Sides like papas fritas and puré de papas are classic accompaniments.

name: Bananas
about:
Bananas is an expression of the team’s take on Asian American food, incorporating classic Asian flavors with Western cuisine. The phrase “Bananas” has previously been used as a slur to describe Asian Americans who are ‘yellow’ presenting but culturally white due to their upbringing in America. Bananas offers a signature menu of American favorites with elements of Asian cooking.

Bananas, a New American restaurant from Chef-Owners Chris Ng (previously of Blue Ribbon and Bond St) and Kyaw Lwin (previously of Yakiniku Futago, Hasalon and Michelin-starred Shmoné), located in the heart of the East Village.

name: Bar Mercer
about: Bar Mercer is a sophisticated neighborhood restaurant and bar in the heart of New York City. It features an elevated pub-style menu with English influences, crafted by Chef Preston Clark. The inviting atmosphere offers refined takes on pub classics, seasonal dishes, expertly crafted cocktails, and a thoughtful global wine list. What makes Bar Mercer special includes elevated pub fare with modern twists like mini pigs in a blanket and "hangover pasta." The menu changes seasonally to ensure fresh ingredients. Enjoy innovative and classic cocktails made with premium ingredients, and explore a diverse selection of wines from around the world. The warm ambiance features black-and-red checkered floors, moody lighting, wood accents, and vintage schoolhouse-style chairs, creating a cozy feel. The design evokes nostalgia with vintage photographs and lamps, making it a charming fixture in the city. Visit Bar Mercer for a unique dining experience in a prime location.

name: Bar Primi Bowery
about: Bar Primi is a corner pasta shop devoted to ‘primi piatti,’ the pasta course. What began as an idea for a small space in New York's East Village has since become an essential in chef and co-owner Andrew Carmellini's range: fresh pasta traditionally prepared and cooked to order. At Bar Primi, the main course is Primi Piatti. We use a variety of non-GMO semolina and specialty ‘00’ flours, organic eggs and handed-down techniques to create our menu of Traditional and Seasonal pasta dishes. We make more than a dozen different shapes and styles daily. This includes lumache and rigatoni from our imported extruder or ravioli and mezzalune cut and filled by hand. Family recipes and secrets are traded between Carmellini and Brooklyn-born chef-partner Salvatore Lamboglia who also offers a daily meat or seafood special in addition to a selection of shareable Piccolini and Antipasti, artisanal cheese, salumi and simple home-style desserts.

Wonderful dinner!  Got there early and had a lovely long dinner with my sister who lives out of town.  Delicious food, wonderful species, live piano, incredible service, and felt like a neighborhood gem.  By the time we left, every table was full.  Will definitely add to my list of faves!
What a terrific find!  Fried tomato rice & papardelle bolognese al fresco amidst rhe hurly-burly of the Bowery.
Wonderful food, always consistent. Great service, helpful staff, lovely ambiance. This is a repeat experience always!

Rare for me to write a review but I’ll make an exception here: Good, solid, food marred by some of the worst service I’ve ever experienced.

Slow, rude (several different waitstaff, apparently rotating, rather than one staff member for a table?), arrogant.

name: Beauty & Essex- New York
about: Beauty & Essex has an innovative design that starts in the restaurant’s entrance, a well-curated modern-day pawn shop replete with a saxophone, boom­box, quirky artifacts, vintage treasures, and an eclectic array of “one-off” pieces of jewelry. Continuing past the pawnshop, guests encounter a grand, circular staircase wrapped around a two-story custom chandelier, but only the adventurous will discover all that Beauty & Essex has to offer. With four distinct dining rooms (one private), two bars, a lounge, and a women’s bathroom complete with a salon including a luxurious sofa, and antique perfume bottles. The cuisine, much like the design, is intended to set a new course. Chef Chris Santos was one of the pioneers of the small, share plate dining trend that has swept the nation, and with the Beauty & Essex menu, he once again has created waves on the food scene.

reviews.text: We waited an hour past our reservation for our table. Their “policy” is that they don’t give estimates on how long your wait will be. I believe their policy is also to overbook and tough luck that your table isn’t ready after a reasonable wait. Unacceptable. The service isn’t exactly polished. The waiter came and introduced himself to us twice and later asked if we were ready for dessert when two of the entrees hadn’t been served yet.

My partner and I have been coming here for years, most especially for Thanksgiving every year we can. The food is outstanding. This year we had sweet potato empanadas, black truffle pizzetta, truffle mac cheese, dumplings, and more! Everything tasted delicious! The desserts topped everything! There was a new maple tree on the menu made with a maple candy floss that tasted divine. We also had the Black Forest dessert and apple cider donuts. Our table was so happy!
Superb food. Wow atmosphere. Great mine choices and many shareable items
It is a fabulous restaurant/bar with a fun atmosphere!

The No. 1 spot for the Knicks, Yankees, Giants and Rangers in Fidi, as well as Premier League, Champions League, 6 Nations rugby, NBA, NFL and NHL. faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
What are the portion sizes like at this restaurant?

Portions at Beckett’s lean generous and shareable, the menu includes group-friendly items (20 tenders, 50 wings, combo platters) and hearty entrees like steak frites and lobster mac & cheese. Burgers and sandwiches come as substantial servings (e.g., two 4oz patties for the smash burger) and there are sides meant for sharing. If you’re feeding a group, the wings, tenders and sliders are practical and filling choices.

reviews.text: Beckett’s is my go-to sports bar in the Financial District. Me and my friends always end up here for a game. The vibe’s always fun, the staff is super chill, and the food is way better than you’d expect. They’ve got two floors, so it’s a great spot for events, too. And seriously, there are so many TVs—it’s hard to miss anything. Plus they play different games, so they aren’t all streaming the same game. I’d say their biggest plus is that you can ask the staff to put on a game you want to watch, and they’ll do it. Not many sports bars do…If you’re looking for a spot to hang out and catch a game, this place is the move.
Went for the football game with my daughter.  Excellent food, easy viewing of the TV’s and fun time.

The staff was friendly and attentive. This just was not what I thought it would be. Have to factor in the impact Hurricane Sandy has had on this neighborhood, lots of places closed for now. Had fish and chips....a bit greasy.

The staff at Beckett's was very kind and accommodating as always! I enjoyed our time there.. but they need to improve their food options. I had a very dry and tough lamb burger and I waited forever for some additional sauce that NEVER came. :-( It wasn't horrible just wasn't 'amazing' either.
I have always loved the seafood Cobb salad.

about: Nestled within the heart of the Meatpacking District is the new culinary gem, Le Coin, on the corner of 13th Street and 9th Avenue. Le Coin introduces innovative dishes crafted by Executive Chef Sebastien Chaoui, inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Paris and coastal France. With indoor and al fresco seating, the restaurant effortlessly blends the bustling energy of New York City in a timeless, charming space adorned with vintage decor and original artwork curated by Paris Chong, Gallery Director of Leica Gallery LA.

Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Black Tap Soho makes a fun, casual date-night spot if you want lively vibes, creative milkshakes, and classic American comfort food. reviews.text: I don’t understand why they only had the basement part of the restaurant open - it was awful down there. It felt like we were sitting in the kitchen.  There were shipment boxes out waiting to be unpacked, the restroom seemed like an employee bathroom.  The wait staff that was working there were VERY NICE, but there just weren’t enough people.  The food was very messy and there were no utensils and not enough napkins.  We order the fried mozzarella which was delicious. The fried pickles were awful, the guacamole was terrible, it was mostly salsa on top of it and very runny, the chips tasted stale. The Oreo cake shake was delicious but beyond messy - it needed to be on a bigger plate and with utensils because it got all over the table. We ordered 2 of the cake shakes…..the cake slice tasted like artificial chemicals and the shake tasted like raw cake batter and again…..it got ALL OVER THE TABLE…..it should’ve come on bigger plates or with extra plates and needed utensils and ALOT of napkins, we could even eat them so we left. The bill was very expensive. We just ordered the guacamole, friend mozzarella and 3 shakes (they said they gave us the friend pickles for free, we didn’t order them) and I think the bill was $185.  The atmosphere was terrible and the food was barely edible.  We had to go next door right after this to have something for dinner because we were starving.
The service was incredible! We were treated very well. It was my boyfriend's birthday and Alex, our server, was very attentive and helpful! I will be back.

Black Tap looked much nicer on the website than in person.  I was very disappointed in the ambiance.  Though the food was good, again it was misrepresented.  It was ok for a quick drop in not for the birthday celebration I had planned.
No real gluten free options offered compared to our black taps we have eaten  in

The food is excellent! But, I was rush by my server. We weren’t there long, had a reservation but got “are you ready for the check” while we were eating. Paid the bill then got asked if we wanted anything else or dessert. Would go again but not this location.

details.hours_of_operation: Daily 4:00 pm–11:00 pm

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Bombay Bistro is a lovely choice for a date night. Guests praise its cozy, charming West Village vibe, creative cocktails, and flavorful, shareable dishes (samosas, lamb biryani, Rogan Josh). The space feels intimate and whimsical, perfect for conversation, though it can get lively and a bit loud on busy nights. For a quieter experience, opt for an early or midweek reservation. Expect generous portions and attentive service that make it feel special.

reviews.text: There was a very large and very loud crowd at the bar that disturbed all the patrons

What an amazing food experience- Alvaro and the other wait staff were stunningly impressive.
The bar tender was relentlessly impressive 🎉😊👍

Lovely little place, love the monkey decor! The palak paneer was perfect, spicy but not too much. The chicken tikka masala could have been spicier but we didn't ask for it to be and we had it with the lamb and together they were delicious. The garlic naan was perfect, just had the leftover paneer and that was still really good the next day. Service was very good, no hovering or rushing despite how small the place is. We recommend going if you're in the mood for Indian.
Excellent food but unsatisfactory customer service.
Food and drinks are outstanding! Pork vindaloo and chicken biryani were delicious - naan and raita are best ever!

faqs.answer:
How is Boni & Mott restaurant rated?

Boni & Mott is rated 4.7 stars by 9 OpenTable diners.

reviews.text: Amazing staff, delicious food, and wonderful environment .. get the chicken!
Tasty, fresh with a great ambience, especially if you catch it on an evening with the open large front windows open. Friendly staff, no complaints! Good music too!

Very nice and cozy Mediterranean restaurant in Nolita, NYC. I love open air seat during the summer and I pick this restaurant because I want to try new place that is not well known yet or too hype in the touristy area.

Food is great, I have a glass of Prosecco with Hiramasa Tartare and Boni's Mussels for appetizers. Citrus-Glazed Lamb Chops and Butterflied Dorade are my main course. I get a surprise cake for my husband which is Brioche pudding and I secretly ask the restaurant to put a birthday candle on the pudding. They do it nicely plus singing Birthday song, that is wonderful.

Service is very nice and I'm glad I eat at this restaurant.
Quite literally the BEST place I have been to for dinner in the city. Food was what dreams are made of and ambiance was spectacular. The octopus, burrata, and chicken are a must!
Excellent addition to the Mott street are. Amazing food and service with a great ambiance. A must try.

about:
Boucherie Union Square is a traditional French brasserie and steakhouse celebrating Joie de Vivre. The restaurant features an ample menu of French classics and timeless bistro favorites, such as the Soupe à l’Oignon and Steak Frites, in addition to delectable dry-aged meats. Alongside an extensive wine list featuring our exclusive Boucherie Wine Collection, guests can enjoy signature cocktails, absinthe drinks, non-alcoholic options, craft beers, and more. Surrounded by majestic wooden-framed mirrors and original Belle Époque posters, our Union Square Location features a variety of inviting seating options. From pristine white marble and wood bistro tables to cozy burgundy leather booths, a 32ft handmade pewter bar, and a private room for up to 40 guests, our 222-seat restaurant exudes timeless charm and Parisian elegance. We look forward to welcoming you!

*Please note that kitchen hours may differ.

Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Boucherie - Union Square is a popular choice for date night. Guests frequently praise its Parisian bistro vibe, cozy booths, white marble tables and a 32-ft bar that create a romantic atmosphere. Expect lively, energetic dining (it can be noisy on busy nights), classic French dishes like Steak Frites and Soupe à l’Oignon, and attentive service that many guests describe as warm and celebratory. faqs.answer:
What are the portion sizes like at this restaurant?

Portions tend to be hearty and satisfying, guests frequently praise the burger-and-fries combo as filling and well executed. Starters such as the Crispy Brussel Sprouts and Jambalaya Arancini are served as shareable apps, so you can build a meal of a few plates and a main. Overall, expect generous comfort-food portions typical of contemporary American casual dining.

reviews.text: Tucked away in alphabet city, the menu is limited, but what they offer is done very well. $22 bottomless mimosas. Generous portion of French toast,shakshuka, and probably the best chicken wings I’ve ever had. Carson was our waiter, friendly and attentive. It was delightful and three of us ate like ticks for under $100 bucks.

The food here was good, but the menu options were very limited. To me, it was a basic place with basic service. You know it's basic when the name of the place comes up for ratings and you have to really think about when you were there (it was only about 3 weeks ago)....speaks volumes. Good food, but I don't think I'll be back.

All was exactly as promised - fantastic service (very friendly, accommodating and knowledgeable about the menu/bar options); comfortable, delicious hamburger and perfect fries! And brussel sprouts with tahini were excellent starter. We have been to many, many, many of NYC's hamburger spots, from holes in the wall to white napkin/tablecloth dining - Brindle Room's burger is among the best.
Came with some friends best burger I’ve ever had good vibe great drinks deff be back soon

One of the best burgers in NYC.
Before the pandemic they were closer to Tompkins park, and were amazing.
Safe to say nothing has changed just the location. Space is larger, but location is slightly out of the way.
More people should visit. True hidden gem.

about:
Introducing Bufón, a new restaurant on the Lower East Side from the culinary team behind Demo. Chefs Quang Nguyen and Dina Fan serve up fare inspired by classic European cuisine, but drawing broadly on international techniques and ingredients. The menu will focus on steak and fish, complemented by a raw bar and produce-driven cooking. The extensive wine list, from Jacob Nass and Pierre Derrien, presents a range of terroir-driven & low-intervention offerings from popular and lesser known regions. Bufón also offers a curated array of spirits and product-driven cocktails.

At its heart, Bufón is meant to be a place for community - for guests to come, stay awhile, and leave with their week lifted and an evening remembered. It’s also a home for the team’s peers in hospitality and the creative industries downtown - a space to gather, unwind, and share a truly good meal, long after the city quiets down.

reviews.text: A delightfully flavorful dinner with many high notes. We loved the squash dish, salad and the new lemon tart. Interesting wine list with friendly and knowledgeable staff. We really enjoyed this meal and the resturant vibes and are looking forward to returning. Overhear many other patrons expressing similar thoughts.

Excellent food and cocktails (highly recommend the phenomenal Sazerac take, and the Radicchio was an inspired combination of sweet persimmon and sesame that is one to remember), with knowledgeable and attentive staff. Bufón was our perfect girls' night!
All around great time, drinks food  and  service.

Warm and welcoming from the moment you walk in. The menu is playful yet dialed-in, elegant without a whiff of stuffiness, and with an exciting, thoughtful beverage program to match. Not a dud amongst what we tried. Particular highlights: the radicchio salad (maybe one of the best salads I’ve had in memory), duck with dates, pork chop with beans, a cognac-apricot cocktail, and a fun skin-contact wine our server suggested to pair with the pork chop. (Excellent and unexpected pairing suggestions throughout the meal.) No notes! Excited to come back.
Another hit from the team behind Demo in the West Village. Highlights were the sunchokes with sunflower butter, clams in the half shell with jeow, and as expected, the wine program.

about: Buona Notte is a hidden gem of a restaurant located in the heart of Little Italy. This intimate eatery serves up delicious Italian dishes made with the freshest ingredients, along with a selection of fine wines. The menu features classic favorites such as pasta carbonara, beef braciole, and tiramisu, as well as a range of daily specials. The cozy atmosphere and impeccable service make Buona Notte the perfect spot for a romantic dinner or a special occasion. Don't miss this hidden treasure in the heart of New York City's iconic Little Italy neighborhood.

about:
Whether you’re in the mood for a classic beer or you want to try something a little more adventurous, Burger Village has you covered. Their fine draft beers and local beers are sourced from some of the best breweries in the area, ensuring you get a high-quality beverage every time you visit. With a wide variety of options, there’s something for everyone at Burger Village.

For those who prefer wine, Burger Village offers a selection of organic wines perfect for pairing with their delicious food. Their knowledgeable staff can help you choose the ideal wine to complement your meal.

And, of course, no visit to Burger Village is complete without trying one of our signature cocktails. Made with fresh ingredients and creative combinations, cocktails are a must-try for anyone who loves a good drink.
