name: Cafe Zaffri
about: Cafe Zaffri, lovingly known as “Zaf’s”, is the third dining concept from the acclaimed team behind New York City mainstays Raf’s and The Musket Room. Located inside The Twenty Two New York, a hotel and private members club located in Union Square. The sprawling restaurant will be open to the public and serve modern interpretations on Levantine cuisine and its diaspora.

details.hours_of_operation: Dinner Daily 5:00 pm–10:00 pm

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Cafe Zaffri is an excellent choice for date night. Guests repeatedly praise the gorgeous, candlelit dining rooms, inventive cocktails, and elevated Levantine plates that make for a special evening. Book a table in the main dining room or a booth if you can request one for a more intimate experience. Note that it’s on the pricier side and can feel sceney on busy weekend nights, so consider an early or midweek reservation if you want a quieter vibe.

reviews.text: Visited solo; the space is beautiful and the ambiance is impressive. Service appeared to be more focused on larger parties, and I felt somewhat very secondary as a solo guest. I ordered a seafood pasta, a side dish, dessert, and a glass of sparkling, though I was asked multiple times if I wanted to order more. It gave the impression that a larger bill was expected, which felt slightly out of place for a solo visit. Food quality was okay. The pasta leaned sour and the dessert was not very memorable for the price. Overall, the setting is lovely, though the solo dining experience felt a bit inconsistent

about:
Caliente Cab Mexican Café is open for lunch, dinner and late-night meals. It also offers a weekend brunch featuring dishes like Mexican French toast and grilled eggs, as well as morning cocktails. Throughout the day, you can order from a list of traditional Mexican items such as fajitas, tacos and burritos. To complement your meal, add flavor to your dish with the freshly made salsa and guacamole.

Caliente Cab Mexican Café provides a casual, bar-like environment. Along with a festive décor, it offers an outdoor patio space for dining with family or enjoying drinks like margaritas, mojitos or sangria with friends.

We also do parties and catering for all occasions!

about:
Casa Colven is a vibrant Colombian-Venezuelan fusion restaurant located in the heart of New York City’s historic Lower East Side, just steps from landmarks like the Williamsburg Bridge and the Tenement Museum. Our menu brings together the rich culinary traditions of Colombia and Venezuela to create a fresh, innovative Latin fusion.

Signature dishes include our golden empanadas de pollo and carne, refreshing ceviche de camarones, and the crowd-favorite Don Patacón sandwich, layered with savory fillings between fried plantains. Each dish is crafted with love and authenticity, designed to transport you straight to the streets of Cartagena or Caracas.

Our atmosphere blends casual warmth with vibrant Latin flair, featuring cozy indoor seating, lively music, and welcoming service that makes every guest feel like family. Whether you’re joining us for a relaxed lunch, date night, or celebratory dinner, Casa Colven offers a one-of-a-kind dining experience rooted in culture, sabor, and soul.

faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Casa Colven is a great pick for a casual, lively date night. The restaurant blends cozy indoor seating with vibrant Latin flair and lively music, making it warm and inviting for couples. Guests praise the welcoming staff and strong service, and the menu has shareable bites (golden empanadas, ceviche) plus hearty mains like bowls and the Don Patacón, perfect for sampling. For a quieter table, consider an early seating.

about: Experience the essence of Italy nestled in the heart of New York City's Little Italy at Casa D'Angelo. Our charming eatery invites you to savor the authentic flavors of Italy, where every dish is crafted with love and tradition. From our home made, fresh pasta to our brick oven pizzas, Cheese Wheel pasta , each bite is a journey through the streets of Napoli or the hills of Tuscany. Join us for a culinary adventure that celebrates the soul of Italian cuisine, right here in the bustling streets of NYC.

What seating arrangements/rooms does this restaurant have?

Cecilia offers indoor dining plus outdoor options, guests mention street tables and a small back courtyard/patio. The team is used to accommodating changing party sizes (hosts have moved groups to larger tables), and the restaurant accepts large parties and private events, so they can organize group seating or private arrangements with advance notice.

reviews.text: Cecilia is truly one of the best restaurants on st marks place. The whole space feels warm and intimate and the food is so thoughtfully crafted. Every plate tasted fresh and balanced. It is the perfect east village dinner spot when you want great cocktails and a relaxed but elevated vibe.

I had such a beautiful night at cecilia. The lighting soft, the music mellow, and the service so welcoming. The shared plates were flavorful and the cocktails were incredible. It really feels like a modern mediterranean spot designed for long conversations and slow dining. One of my favorite east village gems.

Walked into cecilia without expectations and left obsessed. The atmosphere is cozy but stylish and the staff made us feel appreciated from the moment we sat. The shared dishes were perfect for trying everything. It is definitely a must visit restaurant on st marks place.

My friends and I came here before going out and ended up staying because the cocktails were too good to leave. The Pinky’s Garter and French 97 were our favorites. The marinated olives and disco fries were perfect to snack on while we hung out. The whole place gives this modern retro vibe that feels very St Marks and very NYC. Super cute spot and I’m definitely coming back.

came here after work and wow the vibe hit immediately. soft music, really good lighting, super chill but still upscale. the food came out fast and every dish was so good that we ordered extra. cecilia is definitely one of the best dinner spots near east village nightlife.

about: Cha Cha Tang is a restaurant by John McDonald and Wilson Tang. The kitchen is led by Chef Doron Wong and offers a playful rendition of a classic Hong Kong diner, “cha chaan teng” which translates to “tea restaurant.”

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Cha Cha Tang is often recommended for date night. Guests describe a softly lit, speakeasy-like atmosphere with cozy booths, romantic touches and lively yet intimate energy. The kitchen serves playful Hong Kong–style dishes (roast duck, creative fried rice, dim sum and an impressive cocktail and wine list), making it easy to share plates and linger over drinks. For a quieter experience, aim for an earlier seating and mention any special requests when you

about:
A go-to location for wine and cocktail enthusiasts, Cibar Lounge offers fine and fantastic mixed drinks and a delightful snack menu. Party all night with gin and tequila mixed drinks, while snacking on a sweet & salty popcorn mix or pig in a blanket. Cibar Lounge is a classic and upbeat New York destination that packs class and fun all into one.
Guests at the Cibar Lounge have enjoyed years of specialty drinks and vodka martinis as the night flies past. The classic bar serves an upbeat and modern community with a upbeat and inviting ambience.

menu_items.description: Vollendeter hopfenbetonter Pilsgenuss kombiniert mit Leichtigkeit und Eleganz, dazu ein kristallklares, sonniges Strohgelb und ein anhaltender, feinporiger Schaum: Nur aus besten Rohstoffen nach deutschem Reinheitsgebot gebraut, überzeugt unser Bitburger Premium Pils nicht ohne Grund als das meistgezapfte Bier an deutschen Theken. Sein fassfrischer Geschmack macht unser Premium Bier so beliebt. Serving Sizes: 16oz Draft

menu_items.name: Clinton Hall Gigawatt IPA, IPA - American 7.8% ABV The Bronx Brewery, Bronx, NY
menu_items.description: Aroma: Tropical notes, mango, pineapple, guava, stone fruit, pine Flavor: tropical, lactose, biscuit undertones Velvety mouthfeel. Serving Sizes: 16oz Draft

menu_items.name: Sparticle Physics, Pale Ale - American 5.5% ABV Equilibrium Brewery, Middletown, NY
menu_items.description: We took Particle Physics, our Citra based American Pale Ale and added Strata to give this spin off an even more aggressive and fruity dimension. Sparticle Physics pours hazy orange and has aromas and flavors of cannabis from the battle fields of Sparta, tropical citrus, nectarine, and pineapple. Featuring a pillowy mouthfeel and a hole-kicking finish, this delicate and juicy crusher is welcomed by all warriors alike. Serving Sizes: 10oz Draft

menu_items.name: Gridlock Hazy IPA, IPA - New England 6.5% ABV Five Boroughs Brewing Co., Brooklyn, NY
menu_items.description: Hazy IPA offering a tropical traffic jam of flavor. A multifaceted malt bill balances heavy Amarillo and Citra hop additions — bumper-to-bumper deliciousness. Serving Sizes: 16oz Draft

menu_items.name: Nu Haze IPA - New England 6% ABV Southern Tier Brewing Company, Lakewood, NY
menu_items.description: The most crushable Hazy IPA in the game. Made with a special no boil take on the brewing process where fruit forward Idaho 7 and Mosaic hops spend all of their time creating a pillowy soft, juicy experience and no time at all generating bitterness. Serving Sizes: 16oz Draft

menu_items.name: Table Beer, Farmhouse Ale - Saison 4.2% ABV Threes Brewing, Brooklyn, NY
menu_items.description: Lemon Flesh, Cracked Wheat, Fresh, Soft. Serving Sizes: 10oz

menu_items.name: Surfcasting, Grisette 4.5% ABV Oxbow Brewing Company, Newcastle, ME
menu_items.description: Surfcasting is a gently salted grisette brewed with American hops, wheat, and fresh limes. Serving Sizes: 10oz Draft

menu_items.name: Spritzer Bomb IPA - Imperial / Double New England 8% ABV Sixpoint Brewery, Brooklyn, NY
menu_items.description: It's a beautiful thing. When brewers can get together, draw on their existing expertise and make something unique and absolutely delicious. Sloop and Sixpoint have come together over the years to make four versions of these collaborative IPAs, drawing from the source material of Sloop's iconic Juice Bomb, combined with Sixpoint's foray into grain-grape combinations in the small batch Spritzer series. Spritzer Bomb is all the juice of a serious hazy IPA with the tingly finish of sauvignon blanc grapes. Bombs away! Serving Sizes: 10oz Draft

menu_items.name: Tripel Karmeliet, Belgian Tripel 8.4% ABV Brouwerij Bosteels, Buggenhout, Vlaanderen
menu_items.description: Tripel Karmeliet is still brewed to an authentic beer recipe from 1679 originating in the former Carmelite monastery in Dendermonde. Written over 300 years ago, this recipe describes the use of three kinds of grain: wheat, oats and barley. The name Tripel karmeliet thus refers both to its origin and its in-bottle refermentation. From many trial brews of multigrain tripels carried out at our brewery in the 90s, it appears that the particular historic combination of the 3 kinds of grain still remains the ideal blend. Serving Sizes: 6oz Draft

menu_items.name: Golden Monkey, Belgian Tripel 9.5% ABV Victory Brewing Company, Downingtown, PA
menu_items.description: Nose is loaded with Belgian yeast character of banana and clove with an equally fruity body balanced with a light, earthy hop character. Savor notes of orange and spice followed by a dry finish. Serving Sizes: 10oz

menu_items.name: Wave Chaser IPA, IPA - American 6.4% ABV Montauk Brewing Company, Montauk, NY
menu_items.description: Citrus - Pine - Tropical. Serving Sizes: 12oz Can

menu_items.name: Eastern Haze IPA, IPA - Session / India Session Ale 4.9% ABV Montauk Brewing Company, Montauk, NY
menu_items.description: A celebration of those moments when the sun hits the horizon line and casts a beautiful haze across the sky. Uncompromising haze and hoppy goodness, with a lower ABV to enjoy from one end of the day to the other. Serving Sizes: 12oz Can

menu_items.name: BON V!V Grapefruit, Hard Seltzer 4.5% ABV Boathouse Beverage Co., Norwalk, CT
menu_items.description: To create the light, refreshing taste of BON V!V, we use simple, select ingredients—purified water, champagne yeast, and natural fruit flavors. That's it! That's what gets us to our perfect 4.5% ABV. No barley or wheat—we're totally gluten-free. And only 90 calories? We'll cheers to that! Serving Sizes: 12oz

menu_items.name: Más Agave Premium Hard Seltzer Lime, Hard Seltzer 4.5% ABV Founders Brewing Co., Grand Rapids, MI
menu_items.description: Creativity. Flavor. Innovation. Our high-quality approach brought us to the forefront of the beer conversation. It also lead us here: meet Más Agave Premium Hard Seltzer. We've elevated your usual seltzer by adding premium ingredients: blue agave nectar, cane sugar, real fruit juice and a dash of sea salt for good measure. With a bold aroma and crisp taste it's a refreshing foray into the future

menu_items.name: Más Agave Premium Hard Seltzer Grapefruit, Hard Seltzer 4.5% ABV Founders Brewing Co., Grand Rapids, MI
menu_items.description: Creativity. Flavor. Innovation. Our high-quality approach brought us to the forefront of the beer conversation. It also lead us here: meet Más Agave Premium Hard Seltzer. We've elevated your usual seltzer by adding premium ingredients: blue agave nectar, cane sugar, real fruit juice and a dash of sea salt for good measure. With a bold aroma and crisp taste it's a refreshing foray into the future

menu_items.name: Solid Gold, Lager - American 4.4% ABV Founders Brewing Co., Grand Rapids, MI
menu_items.description: Our brewery was built on an attitude of no regrets. An attitude of taking risks to bring the best beer possible to our fellow renegades and rebels. Never brewing to style, but always brewing what we want to drink. Our take on a classic, Solid Gold is a drinkable premium lager brewed with the highest quality ingredients. Challenging what a lager can be? That's something we won't regret. Serving Sizes: 12oz Can

menu_items.name: Narragansett Lager, Lager - American 5% ABV Narragansett Brewing Company, Providence, RI
menu_items.description: Made on Honor for five generations, The Famous Narragansett Lager has been one of the greats since 1890. Pre-Prohibition era drinkers toasted 'Gansett, Dr. Suess illustrated 'Gansett, the Sox scored with 'Gansett, and Captain Quint crushed 'Gansett. Today, the highest rated, heritage American lager (according to Beer Advocate) is brewed to be clean, crisp, refreshing and perfectly balanced. "Hi Neighbor! Have a 'Gansett!" Serving Sizes: 12oz Can

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Does Clinton Hall offer delivery through OpenTable or takeout?

Clinton Hall does offer delivery in partnership with Postmates. Clinton Hall also offers takeout which you can order by calling the restaurant at (212) 363-6000.

reviews.text: I was terribly disappointed when I went to the Clinton Hall which recently opened near in the Financial District. We waited 20 minutes before someone took our order and it wasn't even busy. We finally flagged someone down and asked if she was our waiter and she advised us that she was not our waiter , but she would take our order. I ordered the grilled cheese donut which they advised was not available. I was shocked as this is a staple entree of the restaurant. I ordered the fondue burger instead. my friend had wings. Our food came out 20 mins later. We ate and were looking forward to dessert. Unfortunately the next time we saw our waiter, she was handing us the bill instead of asking if we would like anything else. I so disappointed and probably would not go here again. This truly sucks b/c my office is near by and I was hoping to take my team out on our summer Fridays for drinks and food as this seemed like a fun place to go.
Food was good. Service staff never seemed to be around. Very Prompt when cashing out your check, otherwise nowhere to be found.
Food is really good, not a fancy place at all. Service could have been better
Great burgers and good selection of beers. Bit noisy!
Great burger and beer selections to choose from.  Happy to see some IPAs from Vermont and other "remote" areas on tap. Would definitely recommend this to a beer/burger snob.

name: Clove Garden - Jersey City
about: Clove Garden is a vibrant destination for authentic Indian cuisine in Jersey City, offering a diverse menu, excellent service, and a classy ambiance. Whether you're vegetarian, vegan, or a meat lover, there's something for everyone. Experience the rich flavors of India with dishes like masala chickpeas, a satisfying option for vegans and vegetarians; paneer biryani, a fragrant rice dish with paneer and spices; chicken tikka masala, featuring tender chicken in creamy tomato sauce; lamb vindaloo, a spicy curry with lamb and potatoes; and tandoori chicken, marinated in yogurt and spices and cooked in a tandoor oven. Clove Garden's elegant decor and comfortable seating create a warm atmosphere, while the friendly staff ensures a memorable dining experience. Perfect for any occasion, whether it's a romantic dinner, family gathering, or a night out with friends, Clove Garden is the ideal place to enjoy delicious Indian cuisine.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Clove Garden is a great pick for a date night. The owner describes it as a casual-elegant spot with classy, elegant decor and comfortable seating, and guests praise attentive service and a warm atmosphere. The menu features shareable plates (garlic naan, hummus) and rich mains like butter chicken and lamb dishes, making it easy to create a cozy, flavorful meal for two. Consider a weekday or an earlier seating for a quieter experience.

reviews.text: Great dinner with terrific service. Everything was tasty and fresh. Fantastic garlic naan. BYOB.

Really pleasantly surprised by this place - the service was excellent as Steven took care of our table - the rest of the staff was just as attentive,  the garlic naan and hummus that we ordered is a must have

We ordered a bunch of entrees including lamb rogan josh, lamb biryani and butter chicken. We were happy with all of them - all flavorful without being too spicy

We will definitely go back to try different dishes on the menu
Excellent food and service. You can tell that they put heart into it and are very accommodating. They also made special arrangements like having balloons for the birthday we had.
Extremely delicious!!! Would absolutely come back!

Sit in our open air lounge and transport yourself to the cobblestone streets of Paris, Italy, or Spain where every day is enhanced by the taste from a local barista or mixologist. Cocktail menus to be inspired by our travelers and drinks that emulate top destinations around the globe.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
What seating arrangements/rooms does this restaurant have?

Coffee + Cocktails features an open-air lounge that channels the feel of cobblestone streets in Paris, Italy, and Spain, making it ideal for relaxed coffee or evening cocktails. The dining style is casual‑elegant, so expect comfortable but polished seating rather than formal private rooms. Note the location does not offer private-party rooms and does not accept large parties, so for groups it’s best to call ahead and check availability.

reviews.text: Not impressed!, Arrived on time at 2:30, Friday, no host/hostess greeted us. We reserved bar seating for 2.  The bartender was not focusing on us as customers when he took drink orders, my martini was served in smaller glass, not the usual martini glass, and missed the olives. My friend's drink also was served in smaller glass, since I watched him mixing 3 serving of the same drink. He poured 2 servings in a taller glass and we got the smaller one.  And I am sure the same price.  We ordered 2 different bar snacks and 1 of the order was wrong. I didn't bother to tell him.  The place was not super crowded, but don't book seats at the bar, as ppl and floor staffs bumped our bar stools a lot.  I made a reservation for rooftop lounge for April 5th, hopefully this time is a different experience.

I couldn’t really tell you anything about the place because they screwed up my reservation. I showed up and was told that could only stay for 30 minutes, as they had a private event. Why did they email me to confirm the reservation the day before, then? They were polite and apologetic, but couldn’t ultimately honor the booking. Too bad; it looked like a nice place, but I won’t be going back.

The menus evolve frequently based on what’s in season, with a focus on local produce.

When is the best time to go to Cove?

Early evening can be a great time to visit if you want a quieter experience, and the bar is excellent for a more casual, up-close meal by the open kitchen. Guests noted arriving on the early side of the evening when the dining room was less full, while other comments suggest people reserve Cove for special nights. If you prefer a more intimate table, consider an earlier seating or a reservation for the set-back tasting room.

reviews.text: Best Chef Flynn experience yet!  Amazing food and beautiful space.
Amazing staff and amazing food. Everyone was kind and dedicated to their craft
Way overpriced for all vegetable dishes. Kind of forced to get tasting menu. Only a couple of dishes were great. Cocktails not worth $23; they are like juice with alcohol.
Cove was spectacular last night. May be the best restaurant in NYC!! Original, great vibe and so delicious.

Service attentionné et passionné par les produits et le travail du chef - non avare d’explications,ce que nous avons beaucoup apprécié !

reviews.text: Food and service fantastic. The best meal we ate in New York.

Honestly - I go to Cut a lot given I stay at the Four Seasons Downtown a lot and I keep being massively disappointed so I finally write a review. Always an issue to have the meat grilled without additional butter or oil and just basic salt and pepper seasoning. Every time comes out without respecting the instructions, every time the entire team apologises and we go again for another 20 minutes of wait time. Prices are insanely high, given how mediocre the whole thing is. Meat is far from being exceptional in a city that has some of the best steakhouse on the planet.
Very good food and service. Beautiful bar area. I will return.

We had lunch for a meet up with a few friends.  The porterhouse was amazing.  They cut the piece in front of you and meat is tender and juicy.  I like the peppercorn sauce a lot.  Will definitely come back again with my families.
More smiles needed for some servers. Some of them don’t seem to be hospitable

name: Da Andrea - Greenwich Village
about:
Da Andrea Restaurant is a locally-owned and operated, it is a Northern Italian restaurant in the heart of West Village, New York City that has been around for more than two decades.

Da Andrea offers traditional Italian cuisine, regional specialties, seasonal dishes, an extensive wine selection and craft cocktails for our guests to enjoy. The restaurant's specialty is homemade, handcrafted fresh pasta, which we have perfected since we have opened. The chefs also offer delicious homemade entrees and risotto that are made with fresh, local ingredients, that use traditional Italian recipes. Our menu is designed to offer something for everyone, and the restaurant has been recognized for its excellent food and service.

Whether you are looking for a romantic evening, a special occasion, or just a casual bite, Da Andrea is the place to go for an authentic Italian dining experience.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
When is this restaurant busiest and quietest?

Busiest: weekend evenings, holidays and prime dinner hours (around 7–9pm), when the place fills up and energy is high. Quietest: early dinners, weekday lunchtimes and some early Sunday or weekday evenings, those times tend to be more relaxed and better if you prefer a calmer meal.

reviews.text: Sunday dinner at 5pm, restaurant had a few people in but wasn’t busy, that came around 6pm. Waiters were very welcoming and pleasant, Knowledgeable about the menu and recommended the specials well. We had 3 courses although the portions were plentiful, 3 large meatballs on the starter was immense! Husband had the steamed mussels which he said had a lovely sauce with a kick. All the food we had was delicious, water was topped up frequently and the staff were very attentive to our needs. Lovely comfortable ambience in the restaurant and it was really nice as it got busier with the hum of the other customers. Plenty of staff on so no problem still being seen even when it got busier. Hoping to go back before we finish our trip to NYC
Excellent service, great food, authentic Italian and good portions.
Fabulous appetizers and entrees. Great service from the house staff
Wonderful service, food and staff. Best Thanksgiving ever! Thank you!

Omg, we had so much fun!
Food is outstanding, service top notch, great ambiance.
We got octopus salad, veal ravioli and filet mignon. For real, we can’t decide which one was better.
Can’t wait to go back!

about:
Enjoy traditional Northern and Southern Italian cuisine at Da Nico. The beautiful indoor dining room is a favorite among movie stars, New York Yankees and former Mayor Giuliani. The casual, family-friendly atmosphere welcomes you to dine on “The Best Coal Brick Oven Pizza,” or one of the delicious items on the menu.

Specialties include lobster fra diavolo, baby lamb chops and veal chops. Call for the day’s specials.

During the summer, Da Nico features a large outdoor garden which doubles its normal seating capacity. Da Nico is also available for your private parties.

There are many keys to having a great dining experience. With that in mind, consider Da Nico the master locksmith of Little Italy!

What is the dress code for Da Nico Restaurant - Manhattan?

Casual dress is suggested. Guests typically dine in comfortable, smart‑casual attire, the restaurant is family‑friendly and relaxed, so you won’t need formal wear unless you prefer to dress up for a special occasion.

reviews.text: Great spot for Italian food. Would definitely recommend.

Really wasn't a fan. Took a while to be greeted, past reservation time. While waiting a server let us know we were in the way with our stroller by saying "out of the way, coming through" (while carrying nothing in his hands). We adore Little Italy's charm and were quite disappointed. Our server was good though. Be mindful that you pay more if using a card. If we would've paid in cash it would've been 380 and using card made it over 400 dollars without tip.

Absolutely lovely food and great service. The Gamberi Parmigiana was really nice if you fancy a change for the typical chicken version. Loved the complimentary dessert which was very similar to beignets. I would have preferred some dip for the complimentary bread but it was decent without so can’t complain too much about that. Will definitely visit again when next in New York!

Always fantastic food and service! We have been going to Da Nico for years and it always has delicious food and service with a smile. Very attentive and just wonderful. I brought my nieces and others and they also loved it. Thank you!
Food was amazing! Def coming back when in NY again.

New pizza and pasta spot by chef @frankprisinzano now in the West Village. Like the name, Daddies is plural, for everybody, grandparents, parents, kids, babies... Daddies is for all.

Come and enjoy our Neapolitan inspired pies and our amazing selection of fresh homemade pastas made daily.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
What is the best day to go to Daddies?

Weekdays (Tuesday–Thursday) are likely the best choice for a quieter visit. Guests frequently describe crowded, overbooked weekend evenings, so midweek or early-week dinners will give you a more relaxed experience and shorter waits while still enjoying the restaurant’s pizza and pasta specialties.

name: Daisy Duke's Honky Tonk
about:
Welcome to Daisy Duke's, a Western honky-tonk bar nestled in the cobblestones of 47 Stone Street, NYC's oldest street in the Financial District, where the rugged charm of the Wild West meets the vibrant energy of New York City.
Every corner tells a different story, from repurposed antique props and memorabilia sourced from famous trade shows and movie sets. Bask in an ambiance of live music, comfort food, and classic cocktails, and choose from intimate hideaways to main stage energy.
Daisy Duke's is more than a bar—it's an experience that fuses New York's cosmopolitan edge with the warmth and authenticity of America's heartland.

about:
At Dejavu, Executive Chef brings the rich flavors of the Mediterranean to life with a modern New York twist.
Our acclaimed cocktail program in West Village is created with expert mixologists, featuring handcrafted drinks that often require up to 8–10 hours of preparation. Each cocktail is a work of art, perfectly paired with our Mediterranean-inspired cuisine.
Located in the heart of West Village, NYC, just steps from iconic landmarks, Dejavu is more than a Mediterranean restaurant—it’s a true New York dining destination. With three unique rooms, including the dramatic Desire Room, guests enjoy an immersive atmosphere of live entertainment, surprise performances, and interactive shows.
Whether you’re seeking a vibrant night out, private dining in West Village, or an unforgettable cocktail experience, Dejavu offers the perfect setting for celebrations, intimate evenings, and everything in between.

reviews.text: Good food , loved the steaks, Mac and cheese, fig flatbread.

This was our first visit to the Battery Park Del Frisco’s Grille, and unfortunately, it was extremely disappointing—especially for a Thanksgiving meal. We ended up here because we were late making reservations at the Double Eagle, where we usually go every year, and this location seemed like the next best option. Sadly, it did not come close to the quality we’ve come to expect from Del Frisco’s.

To start, the steaks were poorly cooked, oddly flavored, and arrived swimming in grease. Every dish—from the mashed potatoes to the Brussels sprouts to the creamed spinach—was lukewarm at best. Even the crab cake was tiny and served lukewarm. The restaurant was not crowded, so there was really no reason for the food to be this temperature or this inconsistent.

We were seated right across from the bar, and while the noise was manageable, it wasn’t ideal for a holiday dinner. Our waitress was very pleasant, but I was overwhelmed by the constant upselling of a “laundry membership.” On Thanksgiving Day, when all I wanted was to relax with my family and have a nice meal, being solicited repeatedly felt inappropriate and poorly timed.

We used to visit the now-closed Huntington Grille location and always enjoyed it, which made this experience even more surprising. Spending over $500 on a meal that was not satisfying in any way was frustrating. I’m not sure if this was just an off night, but the quality simply wasn’t there.

Again, staff from reception the time we exited was extremely pleasant and personable.  The food was extremely below standard and I feel robbed.

about:
Denino’s Pizzeria is a landmark in New York, with our award winning, thin-crust pizza.

We originally opened in 1937 as a full tavern on Richmond Avenue, Staten Island until Carlo Denino introduced Pizza in 1951. Since then, Denino’s Pizzeria and Tavern has been renowned for our pizza and Italian cuisine which we always prepare fresh daily. We use our family’s recipes for Chicken Parmigiana, Meatballs and past, over the years we’ve added our own version of tavern favorites like Wings, Scungilli and Hero Sandwiches.
Everything is always made from scratch, never frozen, and cooked to order.

Whenever New Yorkers come home, they come home to Denino’s Pizzeria
for thin crust, crispy, Cheesy Pizza piping hot right out of the oven.

When you visit a Denino’s Restaurant you are sharing in a part of our
legacy and family tradition that started nearly 8 decades ago.

about: Led by acclaimed Ayurvedic Chef Divya Alter, Divya’s Kitchen serves plant-based meals rooted in Ayurvedic principles, using only the freshest, highest-quality ingredients. Everything we serve at the restaurant is made from scratch daily to maximize flavor, vitality, and digestibility. We offer a full lunch, dinner, and brunch menu, and a large selection of teas and other Ayurvedic-inspired beverages. The ambiance is tranquil and warm - the perfect setting for a meal that nourishes the mind, body, and soul.

about:
Dullboy offers a brick-walled cocktail bar & restaurant with a writer’s lounge concept inspired by the cult classic The Shining. With a newly remodeled and heated backyard in the heart of downtown Jersey City, it is the ideal location for an outdoor cocktail hang or an indoor cozy winter night escape. about:
El Castillo De Jagua is a family-owned Domincan restaurant located in the Lower East Side of ,New York. The restaurant is a cozy and welcoming space that offers traditional Caribbean dishes, including seafood, meat, and vegetarian options.

As soon as you walk into the restaurant, you are greeted with warm and friendly smiles from the staff. The decor is simple and elegant. The atmosphere is lively and inviting, making it a perfect spot for a night out with friends or a romantic dinner with your significant other.

The menu at El Castillo De Jagua offers a wide variety of traditional Cuban dishes, with many seafood options like the classic shrimp in garlic sauce. The meat options include popular dishes like carne guisada, and Bistec, all prepared with authentic seasonings and spices

The dessert menu is just as impressive as the rest of the menu, with traditional Caribbean sweets like flan, tres leches cake.

name: Ernesto’s
about:
Ernesto’s is the acclaimed Basque-inspired restaurant from veteran chef Ryan Bartlow, who has worked at world-renowned restaurants, including Akelarre in Spain, Alinea in Chicago, and Frenchette in New York City. At Ernesto’s — which has been named one of The New York Times ‘best new restaurants’ of the year, among other accolades — Bartlow offers a menu inspired by his years spent cooking and living in the Basque region of Spain, mixing signature traditional dishes with seasonal riffs on classic flavors.

Ernesto's is open for dinner Monday from 5:30-9:30pm and Tuesday-Thursday from 5pm-9:30pm with the kitchen closing at 9:45pm, and Fri-Sat 5pm-10pm with the kitchen closing at 10:30pm. We accept reservations and walk-ins. We take reservations up to two weeks in advance with our books opening at midnight.

**Our outdoor tables are WALK-IN ONLY. Please call on the day of your reservation to check for availability.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
How is Ernesto’s restaurant rated?

Ernesto’s is rated 4.5 stars by 130 OpenTable diners.

reviews.text: Excellent, authentic Basque cuisine, great service at the bar and at the table, pleasant ambiance. Will definitely return.

First of all, Sommelier was absolutely fabulous. 
Thank you Ernesto’s for giving us a really delicious dinner! We had a great time, and we will be back.
Great food! Everything is above average. I like salty and savory flavor; but most of the dish are too salty even for me. Services is nice and friendly. All in all a great place to check out.

Ernesto’s was one of the better meals I’ve had in a VERY long time. Their entire team made us feel right at home, with excellent but not over burdensome service. Their food is absolutely next level. If you like Basque/Tapas/Family style meals, you can’t do much better than Ernesto’s!

As Paul Hollywood would say : all style no substance wills be a great description of this place.  It’s Basque cuisine but not the Basque hospitality that I have experienced in Basque Country.

Some great things : people around you paying attention to your glass of water, empty plates, your napkin left on the table which gets folded efficiently, the food delivery with a smile. Ambience was most excellent too!

Ehn things ; a waitress who couldn’t be bothered to check on you (perfectly okay when you flagged her down…but you had to flag her down). We were informed instantly that we had to order everything we wanted to eat at once and they would course it.( This right away tells you that the place is about getting food in you and out but nothing to do with basque hospitality. One can understand some of it because the owners do have to pay rent in NYC, but still!) Au contraire : they delivered the tortilla and octopus right away and then seconds later the crab tarts - Which btw they should tell you to eat right away because the tart shells become sad and droopy as they sit!).  Other food was kinda coursed out but not really.   

The standouts were the octopus where the crisp peppers were as much a star as the tender octopus brightened with the sherry vinegar and the artichokes which while simple were somehow elevated with the almond sauce (reminded me of an ajo blanco). I highly recommend getting toasted bread to mop
Up every bit of the almond sauce. Everything else was disappointing and we left with nothing really making us want to go back.

One nice thing they did was take off the morcilla because it was the most bland morcilla I have eaten in my life!  They didn’t have to, but they did.

Overall not impressive.

about:
A New York City tradition since 2000, Essex is renowned for contemporary steakhouse fare with a Mediterranean twist, Oyster Happy Hours and the Original NYC Bottomless Brunch. A multi-level destination which seamlessly blends the sophistication of a steakhouse with the lively energy of a Lower East Side nightspot, Essex's newly renovated Bar and Dinning Rooms offer intimate seating as well as group dining and event spaces.

The Essex Dinner Menu, guided by Chef Steffen Sander, who has helmed some of New York's top Michelin-Starred restaurants, showcases seasonal ingredients, with extensive vegetarian, vegan & gluten-free options. Share a mezze course with warm pita, indulge in a whole grilled branzino & top it all off with our signature dry-aged Angus and Wagyu steaks. Our iconic Brunch Menu is available both a la carte and as a bottomless brunch with unlimited Mimosas, Aperol Spritz, Bloody Marys, Screwdrivers and Draft Beers.

Yes, FOOD makes a strong choice for a relaxed, creative date night. The artist-run space feels intimate and artful, and guests describe the experience as part installation, part dinner. Seating puts you close to the action (counter and booths), so it’s great for couples who enjoy lively, slightly unconventional dining. Reservations are recommended for special evening

name: Fossetta
about:
Fossetta is a natural wine bar and restaurant in the Lower East Side. Charlene Santiago (formerly of The John Dory Oyster Bar and Reynard) and Josh Even (Tosca Cafe in SF, Breslin Bar & Dining Room, The Spotted Pig) have curated a menu of Sourdough Focaccia, Antipasti, and House-Made Pastas influenced by the flavors of Italy and the Mediterranean. The oft-changing wine list features natural wines from small producers from around the world. Large garage doors provide a casual indoor/outdoor European appeal. Come for a glass of wine and snacks, or enjoy a full dinner, or celebrate a special occasion. Open for Lunch and Brunch as well!

We also offer family-style dinners for groups of 9 or more. Please email hello@fossetta-nyc.com for large party inquiries.

What's the ambience/atmosphere like in this restaurant?

Frank offers a cozy, rustic, old-school East Village vibe, lively, friendly and often upbeat. Guests frequently mention a fun, nostalgic atmosphere with strong hospitality and classic Italian comfort food. Be aware the space is small and music can be loud at times, making it energetic rather than hushed; it’s perfect for casual celebrations and convivial dinners but less ideal for quiet, intimate conversation on peak nights.

name: Funny Bar
about:
In the best-worst location on the Lower East Side, Funny Bar is an open-late hideout with great steaks, the best french fries, the driest martinis, and at least three more menu items. There are solo piano sets early & late night, trios beyond and in between. We serve only steak frites, in two sizes and two distinct preparations — our “bar steak” is a bistro filet with bordelaise, our “big steak” is a bavette with a special seasoning and maitre’d butter. The bar steak comes with McDonalds-style French fries, a homemade mayonnaise, and Heinz-brand ketchup.

We also have a short yet sharp natural wine list provided by Louis Dressner Selections.

Funny Bar
Live Jazz Nightly | Steak Frites Always | Lower East Side, NYC

about: Opened in 1999, Ghandi Caf� serves authentic Anglo-Indian cuisine. Present in a quiet neighborhood, Ghandi Caf� offers an intimate space and an opportunity to escape from the hustle and bustle of NYC. Customers at the restaurant can enjoy Indian classical music while they eat. Appetizers include the cheese poori and the onion bhaji. Notable main dishes on the menu include the chicken tikka masala and the butter chicken. Both dishes are served with garlic naan. The restaurant is good for kids and has a casual ambiance. A good place for lunch and dinner, Ghandi Caf� has a friendly and efficient staff. Apart from the Indian food, diners can enjoy seafood specialties and desserts such as gulab jamon and kulfi.

name: Gansevoort Rooftop
about: The newly transformed Gansevoort Rooftop features a glass enclosure with a brass-framed blue onyx topped cocktail bar, stylish custom patterned lounge seating, Moroccan tiled floors and an outdoor terrace with stunning Hudson River and city views. A custom ornate Italian fresco filled with surreal forbidden fruit trees and wisteria motifs welcomes the outdoors in. The bar and dining room’s menu features coastal European ingredients, fresh light bites, and a cocktail menu crafted to perfection. Guests can enjoy signature dishes including a lemon crusted Branzino, Chakchoucka Salad and Shrimp Pil Pil as well cocktails like “The Rooftop Spritz”, an elevated take on the aperol spritz featuring Gin and notes of Valencia orange or the “Sicilian Sangria” based with a Montepulciano and sweetened by Limoncello. Gansevoort’s rooftop is perfect for a leisurely lunch, sunset apéritivo or late night jazz performance.

faqs.question: FAQs

When is this restaurant busiest and quietest?

Busiest: sunset, weekend nights, and when a DJ or hotel event is happening, guests report high energy and louder music during those times. Quietest: weekday evenings and early seatings tend to be calmer; a few guests found quieter seating by the bar or earlier in the night. Plan accordingly if you prefer a relaxed dinner versus a lively rooftop scene.

reviews.text: It was my homegirl and  I  second time at Gazab,  we went there in 2023 then decide to go there yesterday for dinner and The food is very good. Not great. Reviews made the hype better and than the reality. Staff seemed attentive, but did not actually hear our requests. Asked for one dish to be extra spicy and the other to be mild. name: Gelso and Grand
about: Conceived by a Mulberry street local that was motivated to push the boundaries of a historic block that is in search of its reinvention. Gelso & Grand is situated at the iconic corner of Mulberry & Grand Street. The inviting and informal seating plan of the indoor, outdoor and private dining room boasts the marriage of modern and classic New York dining. We take pride in everything we do. We make all pastas in house, we use a wood fired brick oven for our pizzas. We are an upscale-casual restaurant serving modern Italian fare.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Gelso & Grand makes a great date-night spot if you’re after modern Italian, cocktails, and a lively Little Italy vibe. Guests praise the handmade pastas, pizzas from a wood-fired oven, and a fun, energetic atmosphere. For a quieter experience, request an early seating or a table inside away from the pedestrian traffic; evenings during festivals can be noisy. Consider reserving and asking for a corner or the private dining room for extra intimacy.

reviews.text: We are always coming back. It is a great place to enjoy a good meal, with a nice ambience. From appetizers to dessert, everything is well prepared and very tasty. Highly recommended

Everyone's appetizers and entrees were delicious, the server was friendly, helpful and efficient, the decor; a really nice rustic downtown vibe. We will definitely return.

This place is ok. Not an authentic Italian restaurant. Server was nice but salad came out before the wine. Overall food too spicy. Music way too loud. If you are going to little Italy for the authentic vibe - this isn’t it.

name: Genesis House Restaurant
about: The Restaurant at Genesis House offers an exceptional culinary experience featuring distinctly Korean cuisine. name: Gnocco
about:
Step into Gnocco and be transported to a cozy trattoria in Modena, Italy - right in the heart of the East Village. This hidden gem serves authentic Northern Italian cuisine made with fresh, seasonal ingredients and a passion for tradition.

The menu pays homage to Emilia-Romagna with rich, rustic dishes like handmade tagliatelle al ragù, tortelli di zucca, and the signature gnocco fritto-pillowy fried dough perfect with cured meats and cheeses. Wood-fired pizzas feature crispy, thin crusts topped with classics like margherita or bold picks like bresaola and arugula. Seasonal specials showcase peak ingredients and the chef’s creativity.

With exposed brick walls and candlelit tables, Gnocco offers a warm, rustic ambiance ideal for date nights, gatherings, or a quiet dinner for two.

name: Godunk Thai Street Food
about:
GODUNK is a gathering place for people who cherish food, culture, and a sense of style. Rooted in a love for true Thai street food, we reinterpret familiar flavors through a modern, urban lens gritty, bold, and character-driven, yet still comforting at their core.
At the heart of our menu is Chef Nate, our partner chef, whose expertise, experience, and heartfelt devotion to Thai cuisine shape every dish we serve.
Her philosophy is simple yet profound: “At GODUNK, we want you to feel as if you’re standing on the streets of Thailand". The flavors many of us grew up with have journeyed across the world to Bowery, New York, so you can experience Thai authenticity in its purest, most unfiltered form.
Each dish is crafted to evoke the taste of ‘home,’ expressed through the raw, vibrant spirit of true Thai street food. Contemporary in presentation yet unwavering in identity. Every plate bridges tradition with modern sensibility.

Welcome to GupShup!
Gupshup is a bi-level modern Indian hangout inspired by old Bombay. Chef Gurpreet Singh, prior to joining GupShup was the Corporate Executive Chef of Punjab Grill chain of restaurants in India, Abu Dhabi, Singapore and managed around 16 outlets for the brand. about:
Founded in Tokyo in 1996, Gyu-Kaku has become the world’s #1 Japanese BBQ brand! Thanks to our devoted fans we have reached over 700 locations worldwide. Each day, hundreds of thousands of people gather around the table-top smokeless grill, a centerpiece of our dining concept, enjoying selections of premium meats, just off the grill, and other freshly prepared foods from our kitchens, inspiring laughter, conversation, and a magical dining experience.

Our authentic yakiniku (grilled barbeque) dining experience crowns you the chef. Share a variety of delicious appetizers and premium cooked meats over a flaming grill, paired with Japanese sake, frosty cold beers, or other alcoholic and non-alcoholic options of your choice. We're the perfect spot to enjoy time with friends and family, organize an office party, or to spend quality time with your significant other!

Before you go, don't forget to taste our best-seller Harami Skirt Steak or Prime Kalbi Short Rib among other must-try dishes!

about:
Welcome to House of Domes Italian Restaurant, where the magic of Italy is reborn beneath luminous glass domes in the vibrant heart of SoHo. Chef Vilfrid Hodoj, renowned for his exquisite homemade pasta and perfectly dry-aged steaks, invites you to indulge in authentic Italian flavors crafted with passion and precision.
Step inside to discover a captivating atmosphere—whether you're dining in the elegant elegance of The Study, the cozy warmth of The Garden Room, or the glowing intimacy of The Ember Chamber. Each space tells a story, inviting you to experience Italy through art, architecture, and intriguing design.
earby landmarks like Washington Square Park and The High Line make us the perfect spot to relax and savor a unique culinary journey. Our special features include a charming backyard oasis that transforms your visit into an unforgettable escape.
Come for the stunning beauty and the mysterious allure—stay for the exceptional flavors and unforgettable atmosphere. Buon appetito!

reviews.text:
Expensive Mediocre Food with a View:

Firstly, I made a reservation for Hudson & Co. through OpenTable for 6:30pm on a Saturday night, specifying that we would like a seat near the windows.  This was to be my disabled elderly mother’s last trip ever to NYC/NJ and I thought the view would be a nice treat for her.  Instead, we were seated at a table across the room.  If OpenTable has a field to add special requests, one would assume the restaurant sees it.  But Hudson & Co apparently ignored it.  The restaurant was not crowded at that time and appeared to have free tables beside the windows.  If those were reserved, an apology from the hostess for not being able to honor our request would have been nice.  We decided not to bring it up since we could still see the Manhattan skyline somewhat, and my mother cannot easily move tables.

Secondly, Hudson & Co is not serving food worthy of the prices they are charging. I ordered the cream of fennel soup, which was served a little less than piping hot and was very bland.  My mom ordered a dozen oysters, but each oyster was about the size of a nickel!  I’m not sure we’ve ever paid so much for so little.  I also ordered the grilled octopus.  The menu did not specify whether it was a hot or cold dish, but I assumed something grilled would be hot.  Nope.  The octopus rested on a too-sweet sauce which was cold.  The worst thing I was served was the sauteed spinach which completely lacked flavor.  A little garlic and lemon added while it was being cooked would have gone a long way. My husband’s pizza was decent but nothing special.   All of these dishes had “Manhattan” prices, so we were disappointed.

Go to Hudson & Co. for the view of the Manhattan skyline, but don’t have high expectations of the food.

Hudson & Co offers a good variety of options ranging from sushi to steak to bao buns, immaculate NYC views and great, warm service. We came here for dinner to celebrate a birthday and the evening turned out perfectly. This wasn't my first time here and I will continue to bring friends and family to this gem!
The meal and service were great, dessert not so much!
Good location on the riverfront. Excellent views of downtown and midtown. The sushi choices were a surprise,  but the platter was great.  Prompt and courteous service.  Slightly expensive.
Really loved our experience here. Food drinks and staff were superb!

reviews.text: Il Mulino is our favorite restaurant! All the special touches they do for their food and we love the people who work there!!

We booked a table for a year-end dinner (7 people) at 6:30 PM, but our table wasn’t ready until 7:15 PM. We were also told we couldn’t order appetizers first—the kitchen required us to submit the entire meal order at once, which felt rushed and inflexible.

As a gesture, we were told dessert would be complimentary, but they still appeared on the final bill. No apology, no acknowledgment of the delays or confusion.

Overall, the service fell short of expectations for a special occasion.

Once again this was an outstanding meal, the food was perfect and the service extraordinary. 
This is one of the best if not best restaurants all around that we frequent in the city. The staff and service is beyond exceptional.

my experience was not poor due to the restaurant but poor due to Open Table. They made a reservation in a restaurant that was not open at the time of arrival. I arrived for my reservation t 1:30PM and found the restaurant did not open until 5PM what a big disappointment to a business luncheon!!!. Would not use open table ever again.

Delicious food. So loud and then music played on top of that was so frustrating for dinner conversation. Food was delicious but the service was poor. I think it may have been the server’s first night.

name: Jajaja Mexicana - Lower East Side
about:
A patchwork of culture, community, and comida threading plant-based eaters to the Mexican palate.
Jajaja is where south of the border flavor meets New York City flair to create global experiences rooted in local heritage. The venues feature a playfully curated cocktail program, extensive Tequila and Mezcal offerings, Mexican-style lagers and pilsners from local microbreweries, and plant-based street food with options for both comfort and health. Fresh cocktails, latino music, and vacation vibes transport you to a party in Mexico. Serving lunch, dinner and brunch on the weekends.

Is this restaurant kid-friendly?

Yes, families and groups with teens dine here and guests have celebrated birthdays with children. The focus is creative plant-based Mexican street food rather than a kids’ menu, so if you’re visiting with younger children consider an early seating or ask about kid-friendly portions when you call ahead.

reviews.text: The place is inviting, the server was very attentive and the food was absolutely perfect like every time before. Always consistently delicious! A go to spot!!!!!
Delicious and inventive cocktails and food. Relaxing surroundings. Overall a perfect meal

We love Jajaja it’s a staple in our restaurant outings list. The food is amazing as well as the service. Staff is always so nice and courteous. Birria Tacos as well as the Birria Chilaquiles from the brunch menu are amazing.

Our party of 3 are *not* Vegan and we absolutely love this place! You would never know it’s vegan if they didn’t tell you!
Ps: Koleni is the sweetest and most excellent waiter. It’s the second time he’s waited on us and just love him!
Highly Recommend!
Excellent service, lovely ambiance, and awesome food!

faqs.answer:
When is the best time to go to Javelina - Union Square?

The best times are during happy hour or on Taco Tuesday for value and lively bar service. If you prefer a calmer experience, aim for earlier weekday dinners or an early weekend seating, many guests describe the restaurant as popular and quite busy at peak dinner hours, which raises the noise level.

about: Of all Gabriel Stulman's spots, Jeffrey's Grocery is the one you go to snack on raw bar offerings and indulge in a buttery, lobster roll. As with all Stulman joints — the vibe is lively, the service is delightfully friendly, and the specials are very worth considering. It's a go-to spot for a casual, fun-filled evening, particularly if you're in the mood for oysters, which they source from dozens of local aqua-farmers.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

It can be a fun, casual date-night spot if you and your guest enjoy lively pizzerias, but it’s not ideal for a quiet, intimate conversation. Guests frequently praise the pizza and friendly staff, but many note the place gets very loud, music and crowd noise can make conversation difficult on busy nights. For a cozier experience, try an early weeknight seating or a less-busy time and ask for a quieter table when you reserve.

reviews.text: This restaurant is a hidden gem. The pizza is amazing. Highly recommend the broccolini sausage pizza. Donna was an absolute doll and how she remembered all our orders is a mystery. The restaurant accommodated 17 of us and did a great job!!! Well done!!

We had 6 people.  4 ordered classic menu items 2 ordered pizza.  The pizza was a nice thin crust pizza, the other orders including spaghetti and meatballs had no flavor, no taste.  Everyone was very disappointed.  Sadly this was my choice…not a redo.
Great original pie and the scungili salad was terrific! Service is very accommodating, and allow alterations / additions to menu items.

Staff dropped set of utensils on ground when making new table. They looked around and put back on table.

Staff took a used plate that had pizza crumbs on it when we were seated and used plate to set another table after we gave it back to them.

Two examples of non sanitary practices within minutes of each other.
Nice place, good food. Gets very loud when crowded.

name: Kabawa
about:
Kabawa, a deeply personal restaurant from Chef Paul Carmichael and Momofuku, offers a nuanced and distinct perspective on Caribbean cuisine. Built around a set menu with plenty of choices, it’s a place to take your time, enjoy a meal, and discover something new each time you visit.

Kabawa’s menu is a three-course, $145 prix fixe experience, exclusive of beverage, tax, and gratuity.  The restaurant is divided between kitchen counter seating, an immersive experience with direct chef service, or more secluded table seating.

Structured to showcase the depth and diversity of Caribbean cuisine, our ingredients are thoughtfully procured, fusing local produce from neighborhoods right here in New York with specialty items sourced directly from the Caribbean. 

Every touch point — from the custom mosaics to the ingredient sourcing to the instrumental music — is intentional, tapping into Chef Paul’s upbringing in Barbados to reflect the vibrant, welcoming spirit of a Caribbean home.

name: Kabin
about:
In Norway, cabins—or hytte—are an integral part of social culture. On any given Friday, you’re more likely to find Scandinavians sneaking off to these retreats than working late at their desks, and hytte are also a favorite place to spend long winter and summer holidays.
Experience the food menu curated by Michelin-starred chef Johnny Spero and a stellar beverage program, and embrace the fun Nordic cool in a space inspired by Nordic and Japanese design.

about:
Kalye NYC is an authentic Filipino restaurant that brings the vibrant flavors of the Philippines to the heart of New York City. Rooted in tradition and inspired by the lively food culture back home, Kalye-which means "street" in Tagalog-offers a bold, flavorful dining experience that feels like a walk through Manila's bustling streets, without ever leaving the city.

But Kalye NYC is more than just a place to eat-it's a cultural hub. Alongside our signature dishes, we showcase the spirit of Filipino hospitality through local entertainment, including live Jazz bands, DJ nights, and the likes. Whether you're here for the sisig, the music, or the atmosphere, Kalye NYC welcomes you with open arms and a taste of home.

about: Ketchy Shuby is a sensory experience that transports you to a tropical paradise in the heart of SoHo. Inside, lush green vines hang from the ceiling, vibrant floral pillows decorate plush booths, and warm lighting creates a sunset ambiance. Our menu features eclectic flavors to satisfy every palate. Start with our savory beet tartare, a delightful mix of quinoa, cucumber, and spiced coconut yogurt, or enjoy the decadent pasture-raised chicken with dried apricots, raisins, and rich Madeira sauce. Don't miss the vibrant downstairs lounge, where curated music, evocative lighting, and intimate seating create the perfect atmosphere to connect with friends. Ketchy Shuby is more than just a restaurant; it's a community with a warm and welcoming staff dedicated to making your experience memorable. Discover the magic of Ketchy Shuby and let your senses be captivated.

about: Kid Pizza is a new neighborhood pizzeria right on the border of Chelsea/Flatiron at 157 West 18th Street. Our casual and family friendly spot is perfect for groups, solo dining, or a date. Our 14" pies are inspired by the New York slice, and go along with seasonal vegetable forward dishes meant for sharing and entrees like a garlic roasted chicken & eggplant parmesan. Kid takes its name from the New Yorker’s choice term of endearment, ‘kid’. It is common to hear catchphrases such as “what’s good, kid?” in the New York vernacular when speaking with someone you know well.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
How is Kid Pizza restaurant rated?

Kid Pizza is rated 4.8 stars by 10 OpenTable diners.

reviews.text: Went for the hot pot pizza pie special, it was amazing!
The food and vibe were great, already looking forward to going back.
Great pizza, excellent service. Highly recommend. The Robert zombie is so good.

Kid Pizza is simplicity elevated and it absolutely delivers. Their standout dish, the White Pie al Limone, is one of those rare finds that lives up to the hype. But don’t let the cocktails or wine selection pass you by, both are thoughtfully curated to suit any palate.

The ambience, one of the best I’ve experienced. If I could replicate Kid Pizza’s vibe at home, I’d be doing something right. The low, warm lighting sets the perfect mood. Soft enough to flatter everyone, yet bright enough to actually see your date’s face. It’s like dining under a natural filter that guarantees you’ll walk in glowing [even on your worst breakout days].

Other standouts: the mozz sticks (the cheese-to-breading ratio is on point), the meatballs (just like my grandpa used to make), and the classic pepperoni pie with its crisp cup-and-char pepperoni, a true NYC staple.

We first met the owner a few weeks back, and he told us to stop in. I’d already seen the buzz building on Instagram and it absolutely lived up to expectations. Our server, Elisbeth, was great. She was attentive, friendly, and full of insight about the menu, especially their most popular pie.

All in all, it was a fantastic date night for my husband and me. Great food, great vibes, and even better people. Kid Pizza is absolutely worth the hype.
Delicious Delicious Delicious!!! Seriously? DELICIOUS. Fantastic everything, food service ambiance vibe, wonderful team and terrific owners!

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
What seating arrangements/rooms does this restaurant have?

Kissaki - Bowery offers two primary seating options: Indoor Counter seating, where chefs serve nigiri one piece at a time, and Indoor Table reservations, where sushi is served in flights. The restaurant does not offer private party spaces and does not accept large parties, so bookings are geared toward individuals, couples, and small groups seeking an omakase experience.

reviews.text: First time @ this restaurant and we decided to do the 15 course Omakase menu. The chef was the star of the show - not only was he a top notch professional but he basically taught us a course in sushi preparation and we learned about types of fish we frankly had never heard of before! It's more an "experience" than just having dinner - well worth every penny. The space is dark and somewhat austere but it has a Zen quality to it and really added to the evening. The only thing we both discovered was that as many types of sushi that we enjoy, there are definitely certain types that were not to our liking, but that's what made for a great learning experience. All in all a place to put on your list if you're a sushi lover.

Excellent location and food—next time I would sit at smaller open bar as our chef seemed to get caught up and distracted by larger crowd at time. That said, the bar and extra staff service was wonderful. Sushi excellent!

We made a reservation for the $100 omakase and were given the menu for the more expensive one when we arrived. Our reservation said we were doing the standard and we were the only people in the restaurant. if we hadn’t said anything they would have served us the premium one without asking us what we wanted. Secondly, we asked for a sake pairing and they unilaterally decided to give us the “premium” one which was almost twice as much. They also wouldn’t apply our deposit to our meal even though the reservation stated that was what would happen. Great food but scammy experience.
food was outstanding, pricey but worth it. ambience i give it 3 stars cause the venue is a dark stetch of high ceiling local that doesnt have a vibe to a good japanese sushi place
The food was good and well priced but was took this from 4 to 5 star was the service. Our server took extra care for every small detail. Will go again.

name: KYU NYC
about: Inspired by the global travels of our team of chefs and the discipline of Japanese wood-fired grilling known as yakiniku, KYU offers a rich exploration of interpretive Asian cooking. From our open kitchens, you will discover a world of expertly grilled umami-rich meats, smoke-roasted short ribs, innovative fish and beguiling vegetable preparations, hamachi Crudo, and pork belly baos, and Thai “stone pot” fried rice, along with fabulous hand-crafted cocktails and stunning signature desserts. With award-winning restaurants in Miami, New York, Las Vegas and Mexico City, KYU’s unique brand will be expanding to Los Angeles in 2025. We welcome you with open arms.

name: La Diáspora Bar & Restaurant
about:
Note: Our full kitchen closes at 10pm, and last seating is at 9:30pm. Full bar stays open late.

La Diáspora is a bar & restaurant that celebrates Latin American culture in New York City. From the cuisine — with culinary nods to the century-old Caribbean presence, to the newer wave of Mexican, Central, and South American residents — to the ambiance — hand-painted tropical imagery, eclectic cumbia, salsa, merengue, and reguetón playlists — La Diáspora is a love letter to the wonderful, unique, and ever growing Latin American community of NYC. The kitchen is helmed by Paolo Peralta (Hecho en Dumbo, Gran Eléctica, Aldama).

With two separate dining rooms — each featuring 60+ seating capacity — plus a full, separate bar — with its own 35 seats — La Diáspora can accommodate over 160 guests in its approximately 5000 sq ft, and is available for private events, including large, family-style dinners, film shoots, panels, corporate mixers, weddings, and more.

name: La Marchande
about:
Nestled within The Wall Street Hotel, La Marchande is Chef John Fraser’s modern French chophouse in New York’s Financial District—where seasonal French cuisine meets the timeless tradition of the New York steakhouse. The dining room blends café-inspired elegance with intimate booths, while the Water Street-facing bar offers a lively setting for cocktails and light bites.

Signature dishes include French Onion Dumplings, King Crab Tagliatelle, Parker House Rolls with House Made Ricotta, Montauk Hake, and an array of Prime Cuts featuring both American and imported beef.

Corporate Pastry Chef Sofia Schlieben’s desserts, from Dark Chocolate Soufflé to Crème Brûlée, highlight French technique with modern flair. Award-winning Wine Director Amy Racine curates a 200+ bottle French-focused list, alongside the Martini Marché—an interactive martini experience with custom garnishes. Whether for dinner, cocktails, or a special night out, La Marchande delivers refined dining in the heart of FiDi.

reviews.text: Sadly it smelled terribly of pot the moment I walked inside the hotel / restaurant. I had a headache my entire meal and ended up taking the main food to go.  In general the food was mediocre as well. Unoriginal and the rolls were raw dough at the base. For $160 for Thanksgiving, this was not worth it.
Great food and service. The vibe was laid back but trendy. Not crowded.  Recommend the crab tagliatelle.

Our service was excellent but for fine dinning it was very expensive for mediocre food, nothing really blew us away. Our steak was not quite medium rare as we asked for and was missing flavor. We were not impressed by the dessert either our donuts were bite size and also lacking in flavor. We probably won't be back.

Visited on a Sunday evening. At the time it was extremely quiet. About half way through our meal a large world gathering formed but even then the noise was welcome. Service was outstanding. Certainly felt like we were the only diners in that regard. Jonah crab pasta, caramelle, octopus, and Parker house rolls with anchovies and butter were all superb. Would definitely dine at La Marchande again

We went for 2 birthdays- our service was horrible. What should have been a 2 hour meal was almost 4 because the waiter never came around. We ended up asking other server for help- never refilled waters, brought the wrong items, the food came out at different times. The whole thing was a mess.

about: La Nonna is a casual dining Italian restaurant in New York, serving traditional dishes like calamari, buffalo mozzarella, and Portobello mushrooms with prosciutto. Using the best possible ingredients, La Nonna creates classic pastas you’re sure to love, including bowtie pasta with smoked salmon in mascarpone chive sauce and spaghetti carbonara tossed with pancetta, egg yolk, cream and onions. You’ll find an extensive selection of pizzas and paninis for lovers of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisines at La Nonna, as well. Located in Little Italy, La Nonna offers a classic Italian environment in which to enjoy all your favorite wines and pastas. Sporting a white-tablecloth setting indoors and a more casual dining experience outdoors at sidewalk tables, La Nonna can accommodate both small and large parties looking for delicious Italian fare.

name: l'abeille
about:
Nestled on a charming Tribeca cobblestone street corner, l’abeille is an intimate sanctuary where French culinary artistry meets Japanese finesse. With only 48 seats, this hidden gem captivates diners with its seasonal Chef’s Tasting Menu, meticulously crafted by the visionary Chef Mitsunobu Nagae. Drawing on his rich experience from Michelin-starred establishments in Tokyo, Paris, and New York, including a recent tenure as Chef de Cuisine at Shun in Midtown Manhattan, Chef Mitsu curates a symphony of flavors that transcend borders.

At l’abeille, guests experience a harmonious blend of French sophistication and Japanese precision. Complementing the exquisite tasting menu is a rotating selection of seasonal a-la-carte dishes, thoughtfully paired with selections from the wine cellar and a captivating cocktail program. Immerse yourself in an unparalleled dining experience at l’abeille, where each dish tells a story and every moment is a celebration of culinary excellence.

about:
L’amore is an authentic Italian restaurant located in the heart of Little Italy in New York. Join us on a journey of discovery through the beautiful coasts of Italy’s charming culture, delicious foods, drinks and traditions.

The authentic, warm and Italian environment is perfect place for meeting up with friends or to share special moments with the people you love. Enjoy Italian food, wine and culture that showcase the magic of Italian cuisine.

All our dishes are made with love and each and every ingredient has something to add to the flavor.

The homemade dishes will have different flavors exploding in your mouth when eating them in the authentic Italian restaurant L’amore.

faqs.question: FAQs
faqs.answer:
Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, L'Amore is frequently recommended for date night. Guests praise the cozy, warm atmosphere, attentive staff, and authentic Italian dishes that make it feel special for a first date or celebration. Expect a casual-dining vibe with flavorful plates like fresh burrata, risotto and desserts that guests rave about. Consider an evening reservation to secure a cozy table and enjoy a post-dinner stroll through Little Italy.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. The atmosphere was cozy and stylish, perfect for a relaxed meal or a special occasion.

I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and great service!
Very good food, friendly and efficient service. An enjoyable experience.

The food was terrible. Maybe the worst Italian food I have ever had. We were able to seat our party of 8 no problem and now we know why...The servers were nice, but did not properly remove the meal that was sent back from the ticket. The veal was sent back because it was beaten to a very VERY flat slab then fried and dried out in old oil.
We had a group meal before the New York Marathon, and had a great experience. ￼
This was the most authentic and delicious restaurant I have been to stateside! Would highly recommend!

about:
Lavagna opened its doors on February 1st 1999.The restaurant offers casual Italian trattoria fare at moderate prices. The vibe is candlelit, cozy, with an old wood burning oven, exposed brick walls, a pressed tin ceiling and a small wine bar where one can dine also. A wall of French doors swing open in the warmer weather to a seasonal sidewalk cafe of 20 seats.
The kitchen concept is to create dishes traditionally Italian, emphasizing fresh, seasonal ingredients and product of the highest quality.
The menu highlights include homemade pastas, a wood oven roasted fish for two, roast pork chop, baby rack of lamb and of course the rigatoni with sweet and spicy sausage that has become a classic over the years.
The wine list has been a yearly recipient of the Wine Spectator Award of Excellence since 2002 and it focuses on hard to find wines from regional Italy along with other international selections.

Why they're an Icon

Executive chef: Angie Mar

From the OpenTable editors: Famed chef Angie Mar goes big on nostalgic ’80s and ’90s French-influenced dishes like oysters mornay and crêpes suzette at this sleek West Village restaurant. Expect the energy of The Beatrice Inn and the finesse of Les Trois Chevaux—a match you cannot beat.

Philosophy

Let us bring you to a place you never knew you needed. The dining experience speaks to our innermost desires. It is our belief that our best memories, best friendships, and pivotal moments can be found at a dinner table. For us, a remarkable dining experience is the connection, emotional and cerebral reaction that one has while being utterly transported by the atmosphere, experience and cuisine.

details.description: Experience luxurious, modern Continental cuisine at Restaurant Le B., a vibrant fine-dining destination rooted in the rich culinary culture of Downtown Manhattan. Helmed by the acclaimed Chef Angie Mar, our menu revives forgotten indulgences from land, air, and sea, blending history with bold, tableside presentations and signature extravagance. A multi-award-winning restaurant, Restaurant Le B. has earned Four Stars from Forbes, Best New Restaurant accolades from Conde Nast Traveler, Financial Times, and Robb Report, and was named one of Esquire Magazine’s 50 Best Restaurants in America. With an atmosphere inspired by Chef Mar’s legendary Beatrice Inn, our dining experience is both sophisticated and playfully indulgent. *PLEASE NOTE: Le Burger is only available on a pre-order basis, with a limited amount of bookings nightly. In order to experience Le Burger, you must book using the Le Burger Reserve link in our profile, or partake in our Seasonal Tasting Menu.

What's the ambience/atmosphere like in this restaurant?

about:
New Contemporary American restaurant coming to the Lower East Side at the beginning of September.

Leciel is a contemporary American restaurant that reimagines classic flavors with bold, inventive twists. Every dish is crafted to awaken your senses, combining familiar comfort with unexpected flavors and textures.

With our chef’s talent leading the way, we turn contemporary American cuisine up a notch — seasonal ingredients, bolder flavors, and crafted cocktails that keep curiosity flowing. Each dish is curated to feel familiar, yet surprising to awaken your senses, reflecting the spirit of friendship and creativity that started it all.

At Leciel, our bar celebrates creativity, offering non-traditional cocktails crafted with shochu, soju, sake, and fine wines — a modern twist on full-liquor drinks that surprises and delights with every sip.

Is this a good pick for date night?

Yes, Liberty Prime Steakhouse is frequently recommended for date night. Guests praise the warm, romantic ambience, attentive service, and high-quality steaks and cocktails (the Montgomery and Strawberry Lemonade Martini get shout-outs). reviews.text: Having eaten there before, was looking forward to a nice, Thanksgiving dinner. The whole experience was pretty terrible. To start, the menu was not the normal menu, but only the Thanksgiving prix fixe menu... with 3 things on it. 2 steak entrees and their turkey dinner special. All very over priced. The service was SLOW - the entrees took over 90 minutes to come out. And, the wait staff clearly did not want to be there. I had to chase down the wait person to get the check (they were busy on their phone and hanging with other wait staff). Very unfortunate - was not the holiday meal I had expected from a normally great place to eat.
We really enjoyed Liberty Prime Steakhouse for their special Thanksgiving dinner. The service and food was very good!

Awesome place. Sort of an old school steakhouse. I ordered the 10oz filet and it seemed smaller than 10oz… was also a little overcooked. Asked for salt and the waiter brought me the cheap salt shaker. I then asked him for proper salt, which he went and got me black salt from the kitchen. Service was great, other than him bringing me the cheap unhealthy table salt shaker…. I’d go back!
Apps were really good. We asked for medium steaks but it came out well done. Sides were mid. Service was good. Vibes were mid 3/5
Juicy and delicious ribeye. Perfect ambiance and excellent service. Thanks for the perfect dinner!

name: Lil' Frankie's
about:
Italy's neighorhood pizzeria's are known as really casual places to hang out, meet friends, eat, drink and talk. Lil' Frankie's is just that. We offer real Neapolitan pizza, made exactly as it's made in Naples, fresh handmade pastas cooked to order, a wine and grappa list that rivals any in the city, and friendly (never pushy) service - all in a setting designed to make you feel at home.

Our brick, wood burning, oven was handcrafted by a 3rd generation Neapolitan oven builder, brick by brick. It features real lava from Vesuvio and through a unique double dome design, recycles heat to reach near 900 degrees.
